```csv
tutorial.battle_management,Get Capsules. Use your Tokens on the Gacha Machines to get new units and items! Each machine has a different cost per Tier. Every token counts!,Obtenha Cápsulas. Use suas Fichas nas Máquinas Gacha para obter novas unidades e itens! Cada máquina tem um valor diferente dependendo do seu Tier. Cada ficha conta!
tutorial.battle_management_intro.title,Gacha Machines,Máquinas Gacha
tutorial.btn.got_it,Got it!,Entendi!
tutorial.btn.next,Next,Próximo
tutorial.equip,"Choose your equipment wisely. Units have limited slots, and once an item is equipped, it cannot be removed. Every choice counts!","Escolha seu equipamento com sabedoria. Unidades têm espaços limitados e, uma vez equipado, um item não pode ser removido. Cada escolha conta!"
tutorial.first_draw.title,Building your Lineup,Montando sua Formação
tutorial.first_draw_1,"Acquired capsules go to your Shelf. From there, you can place units in your Lineup or equip and use items. If the Shelf is full, new capsules go straight to the Discard.","Cápsulas adquiridas vão para a sua Estante. De lá, você pode colocar unidades na sua Formação ou equipar e usar itens. Se a Estante estiver cheia, novas cápsulas vão direto para o Descarte."
tutorial.first_draw_2,"The turn order is determined by the slot the units occupy, starting with the first slot on the enemy side and alternating slot by slot (occupied or not) between the sides. This means units closer to the front act earlier. The battle ends when all units on one side or the Hero are knocked out! Press ""Ready!"" when you are satisfied with your Lineup.","A ordem de ação no turno é determinada pela casa que as unidades ocupam, começando pela primeira casa do lado inimigo e alternando casa por casa (ocupadas ou não) entre os lados. Isso significa que, quanto mais à frente estiver uma unidade, mais cedo ela vai agir. A batalha termina quando todas as unidades de um lado forem nocauteadas ou o Herói for nocauteado! Aperte ""Pronto!"" quando estiver satisfeito com sua Formação."
tutorial.first_draw_combat.title,Battle Rules,Regras de Batalha
tutorial.gacha_inspect_battle,Changes to your inventory or units that happen on the battlefield do not affect your collection!,Mudanças no seu inventário ou nas unidades durante a batalha não afetam sua coleção!
tutorial.gacha_inspect_battle.title,Battle Capsules,Cápsulas de Batalha
tutorial.gacha_inspect_run.mouse,Gacha Collection: This is your current collection. Hover over a GachaBall to inspect it!,Coleção Gacha: Esta é a sua coleção atual. Passe o mouse sobre uma GachaBall para inspecioná-la!
tutorial.gacha_inspect_run.title,Gacha Collection,Coleção Gacha
tutorial.gacha_inspect_run.touch,Gacha Collection: This is your current collection. Press and hold a GachaBall to inspect it!,Coleção Gacha: Esta é a sua coleção atual. Pressione e segure uma GachaBall para inspecioná-la!
tutorial.gambling_den,Risk it all for gold. Earn tokens from the challenge to spend on these machines for immediate gold rewards.,Arrisque tudo por ouro. Ganhe fichas no Desafio para gastar nestas máquinas em recompensas imediatas de ouro.
tutorial.loadout,Choose your hero and flashcard deck. Heroes have special abilities that can change drastically how the game plays and the deck is the flashcard deck that will be used throughout the entire run.,Escolha seu herói e deck de flashcards. Heróis têm habilidades especiais que podem mudar drasticamente como o jogo flui e o deck é o baralho de flashcards que será usado por toda a jogatina.
tutorial.merge_choice,"Choose Merge to combine two into a single, more powerful entity, or Swap to reorganize your ranks? The choice is yours.","Escolha Fundir para combinar dois em uma única entidade mais poderosa, ou Trocar para reorganizar suas fileiras? A escolha é sua."
tutorial.new_card_intro,"After every Challenge (or every streak of 3 correct answers), a new flashcard enters your Active Deck. This screen shows your newly added card and the flashcards with the lowest current mastery for you to review before the Challenge. Memorize a few because your tokens for this turn depend on it!","A cada Desafio (ou a cada sequência de 3 acertos), um novo flashcard entra no seu Deck Ativo. Esta tela mostra a sua carta recém-adicionada e os flashcards com o menor domínio atual para você revisar antes do Desafio. Memorize alguns porque suas fichas para esse turno dependem disso!"
tutorial.new_card_intro.title,New Flashcard and Review,Novo Flashcard e Revisão
tutorial.path_choice_1,Choose your next Destination! Each Destination counts as a day and your enemies get stronger each day! Keep progressing to win!,Escolha seu próximo Destino! Cada Destino conta como um dia e seus adversários ficam mais fortes a cada dia! Continue progredindo para vencer!
tutorial.path_choice_intro.title,Path Choice,Escolha do Caminho
tutorial.rest_site,"A moment of respite. Master the flashcard challenge to earn tokens, then spend them on these machines for permanent Hero upgrades.",Um momento de descanso. Domine o Desafio de flashcards para ganhar fichas e use-as nestas máquinas para upgrades permanentes do Herói.
tutorial.shop,"Spend Gold to expand your collection. Reroll the stock if you're looking for something specific, but be warned: the price rises with every roll!","Gaste Ouro para expandir sua coleção. Rerole o estoque se estiver procurando algo específico, mas cuidado: o preço sobe a cada rolagem!"
tutorial.shrine_intro,The Shrine lets you shape your Gacha Collection for this run.\n\nRemove a capsule to take it out of your current collection for the rest of the run.\nRemoval costs 5 gold and increases by 1 each time for the rest of the run.\n\nTransform a capsule into a different random capsule of the same tier.\nTransforming always costs 5 gold and does not increase.,O Santuário permite ajustar sua Coleção de Cápsulas durante a partida.\n\nRemover uma cápsula a retira da sua coleção atual pelo restante da partida.\nRemover custa 5 de ouro e aumenta em +1 a cada uso pelo restante da partida.\n\nTransformar uma cápsula a converte em outra cápsula aleatória do mesmo nível.\nTransformar sempre custa 5 de ouro e não aumenta por ativação.
tutorial.shrine_intro.title,Removing and Transforming,Removendo e Transformando
tutorial.training_grounds,A place to hone your hero's power. Earn tokens from the challenge to spend on these machines for permanent Power upgrades.,Um lugar para aprimorar o poder do seu herói. Ganhe fichas no Desafio para gastar nestas máquinas em upgrades permanentes de Poder.
tutorial.traits,Lineups with units of the same Trait can activate Synergies that grant special effects and buffs if you have obtained the Crest or trinkets that affect that Trait. Hover over units to inspect and discover their Traits!,Formações com unidades do mesmo Tipo podem ativar Sinergias que concedem efeitos especiais e buffs se você tiver obtido o Brasão ou amuletos que afetam aquele Tipo. Passe o mouse sobre as unidades para inspecionar e descobrir seus Tipos!
tutorial.traits.mouse,Lineups with units of the same Trait can activate Synergies that grant special effects and buffs if you have obtained the Crest or trinkets that affect that Trait. Hover over units to inspect and discover their Traits!,Formações com unidades do mesmo Tipo podem ativar Sinergias que concedem efeitos especiais e buffs se você tiver obtido o Brasão ou amuletos que afetam aquele Tipo. Passe o mouse sobre as unidades para inspecionar e descobrir seus Tipos!
tutorial.traits.touch,Lineups with units of the same Trait can activate Synergies that grant special effects and buffs if you have obtained the Crest or trinkets that affect that Trait. Press and hold to inspect units and find out their Traits!,Formações com unidades do mesmo Tipo podem ativar Sinergias que concedem efeitos especiais e buffs se você tiver obtido o Brasão ou amuletos que afetam aquele Tipo. Pressione e segure para inspecionar as unidades e descobrir seus Tipos!
tutorial.traits.title,Traits and Synergies,Tipos e Sinergias

unit_dust_elite_t1.desc,"At end of turn, summon units to fill empty team slots. Spawns a T1 Dust unit when an Ally is knocked out. Gains HP and PWR based on the tier of any Dust unit that is knocked out (e.g., +1/+1 for T1, +2/+2 for T2). Spawns a Dust unit at Turn Start. Spawns a Dust unit when Attacking.","No final do turno, invoca unidades para preencher espaços vazios. Invoca um Recruta de Poeira T1 quando um aliado é nocauteado. Ganha Vida e Poder com base no tier de qualquer unidade de Poeira que seja nocauteada (ex: +1/+1 para T1, +2/+2 para T2). Invoca um Recruta de Poeira no início do turno. Invoca um Recruta de Poeira ao atacar."
unit_dust_elite_t1.name,Dust Guard (T1),Guarda de Poeira (T1)
unit_dust_elite_t2.desc,"At end of turn, summon units to fill empty team slots. Spawns a random T1 or T2 Dust unit when an Ally is knocked out. Gains HP and PWR based on the tier of any Dust unit that is knocked out (e.g., +1/+1 for T1, +2/+2 for T2). Spawns a Dust unit in the player's inventory.","No final do turno, invoca unidades para preencher espaços vazios. Invoca um Recruta de Poeira T1 ou T2 aleatório quando um aliado é nocauteado. Ganha Vida e Poder com base no tier de qualquer unidade de Poeira que seja nocauteada (ex: +1/+1 para T1, +2/+2 para T2). Invoca um Recruta de Poeira no inventário do jogador."
unit_dust_elite_t2.name,Dust Sentinel (T2),Sentinela de Poeira (T2)
unit_dust_elite_t3.desc,"At end of turn, summon units to fill empty team slots. Spawns a random T1, T2 or T3 Dust unit when an Ally is knocked out. Gains HP and PWR based on the tier of any Dust unit that is knocked out (e.g., +1/+1 for T1, +2/+2 for T2).","No final do turno, invoca unidades para preencher espaços vazios. Invoca um Recruta de Poeira T1, T2 ou T3 aleatório quando um aliado é nocauteado. Ganha Vida e Poder com base no tier de qualquer unidade de Poeira que seja nocauteada (ex: +1/+1 para T1, +2/+2 para T2)."
unit_dust_elite_t3.name,Dust Overlord (T3),Soberano de Poeira (T3)
unit_dust_t1.desc,"When entering a Lineup, gains 1 Burn and 1 Static.","Ao entrar na Formação, ganha 1 de Chamas e 1 de Estática."
unit_dust_t1.name,Dust Minion (T1),Recruta de Poeira (T1)
unit_dust_t2.desc,"When entering a Lineup, gains 2 Burn and 2 Static.","Ao entrar na Formação, ganha 2 de Chamas e 2 de Estática."
unit_dust_t2.name,Dust Minion (T2),Recruta de Poeira (T2)
unit_dust_t3.desc,"When entering a Lineup, gains 3 Burn and 3 Static.","Ao entrar na Formação, ganha 3 de Chamas e 3 de Estática."
unit_dust_t3.name,Dust Minion (T3),Recruta de Poeira (T3)
boss_dustmon.name,Dustmon,Dustmon
boss_dustmon.desc,"The sovereign ruler of dust. Adds dust minions in the player's gacha machines, feasts on fallen allies, grows when dust minions merge, and gains power from all dust in existence.","O governante soberano da poeira. Adiciona recrutas de poeira nas máquinas de gacha do jogador, alimenta-se de aliados caídos, cresce quando recrutas de poeira se fundem e ganha poder de toda a poeira existente."
boss_toughmon.name,Toughmon,Toughmon
boss_toughmon.desc,The armored bastion commander. Hardens itself with armor from living allies and commands frontline troops with armor and spikes.,O comandante bastião blindado. Endurece a si mesmo com armadura de aliados vivos e comanda tropas de frente com armadura e espinhos.
boss_doppelkun.name,Doppelkun,Doppelkun
boss_doppelkun.desc,The elusive mirror entity. Reflects the true strength of the opposing Hero upon entering battle.,A entidade espelhada esquiva. Reflete a verdadeira força do Herói adversário ao entrar na batalha.
elite_slimeblob.name,Slimeblob,Gosmobolha
elite_slimeblob.desc,"[color=#ffd166][b]When Taking Damage[/b][/color], if it is not knocked out, summons a Level 1 Spikeslime into the first empty slot.","[color=#ffd166][b]Ao Receber Dano[/b][/color], se não for nocauteada, invoca um Gosmespinho Nível 1 no primeiro espaço vazio."
elite_burnie.name,Burnie,Burnie
elite_burnie.desc,A raging flame elemental. Deals bonus damage equal to target's Burn stacks and ignites battlefield slots.,Um elemental de fogo furioso. Causa dano adicional igual aos acúmulos de Chamas do alvo e incendeia espaços no campo.
unit_spikeslime.name,Spikeslime,Gosmespinho
unit_spikeslime.desc,A spiky slime minion. Enters battle bristling with sharp thorns.,Um lacaio de gosma pontiagudo. Entra em batalha eriçado de espinhos afiados.
trinket.banner_lone_whale.name,Banner: Lone Whale,Estandarte: Baleia Solitária
trinket.banner_lone_whale.desc,"Deploys a single colossal Soliwhale in Slot 0 with massive stats, drawing immense power from empty allied slots. Reinforcements are completely disabled.","Mobiliza uma única Baleia Solitária colossal no Espaço 0 com atributos massivos, absorvendo imenso poder de espaços aliados vazios. Reforços são completamente desativados."
trinket.banner_swarm.name,Banner: Swarm,Estandarte: Enxame
trinket.banner_swarm.desc,"Floods all lineup slots with inexpensive units, prioritizing maximum board saturation over raw tiers. At odd turn ends, calls in wave reinforcements to replenish any fallen ranks.","Inunda todos os espaços da linha com unidades de baixo custo, priorizando saturação total do tabuleiro em vez de ranques altos. No final de turnos ímpares, chama ondas de reforço para repor baixas."
trinket.banner_fire_phalanx.name,Fire Banner,Estandarte de Fogo
trinket.banner_fire_phalanx.desc,"An aggressive frontline anchored by Fire and Mecha synergies, spreading Burn and retaliating on hit. At odd turn ends, summons Fire reinforcements and tactical allies equipped with Fire Emblems.","Uma vanguarda agressiva ancorada em sinergias de Fogo e Mecatômico, espalhando Chamas e retaliando ao ser atingida. No final de turnos ímpares, invoca reforços de Fogo e aliados táticos com Emblemas de Fogo."
trinket.banner_dustmon.name,Banner: Dustmon,Estandarte: Dustmon
trinket.banner_dustmon.desc,"Dustmon commands from the backline while waves of reinforcements fill the front ranks, triggering its resonance and stat growth each time an ally is knocked out. Summons reinforcements at odd turn ends.","Dustmon comanda da retaguarda enquanto ondas de reforços ocupam a linha de frente, ativando sua ressonância e seu crescimento de atributos sempre que um aliado é nocauteado. Invoca reforços no fim dos turnos ímpares."
trinket.banner_toughmon.name,Banner: Toughmon,Estandarte: Toughmon
trinket.banner_toughmon.desc,"Toughmon fortifies the backline behind an impenetrable phalanx of heavy Tanks equipped with defensive gear, sharing innate Tank trait synergies. Summons heavy Tank reinforcements at odd turn ends.","Toughmon fortifica a retaguarda atrás de uma falange impenetrável de Tanques pesados com equipamentos defensivos, compartilhando sinergias da Tipo Tanque. Invoca reforços de Tanques pesados no final de turnos ímpares."
trinket.banner_doppelkun.name,Banner: Doppelkun,Estandarte: Doppelkun
trinket.banner_doppelkun.desc,"Doppelkun leads from the front, flanked exclusively by shape-shifting Mimicloaks that mirror opposing player units at turn start. Summons replacement Mimicloaks at odd turn ends.","Doppelkun lidera na frente, ladeado exclusivamente por Mantos Mímicos transmorfos que espelham unidades inimigas opostas no início do turno. Invoca Mantos Mímicos substitutos no final de turnos ímpares."
trinket.banner_slimeblob.name,Banner: Slimeblob,Estandarte: Gosmobolha
trinket.banner_slimeblob.desc,"Slimeblob's gelatinous banner. At turn start, summons a Level 1 Spikeslime into the first empty slot. If all slots are full, levels up the first non-max Spikeslime from front to back. If all Spikeslimes are max level, heals the front Spikeslime for 3 HP and grants it +2 Spikes.","O estandarte gelatinoso da Gosmobolha. No início do turno, invoca um Gosmespinho Nível 1 no primeiro espaço vazio. Se todos os espaços estiverem cheios, sobe o nível do primeiro Gosmespinho que não esteja no nível máximo da frente para trás. Se todos os Gosmespinhos estiverem no nível máximo, cura o Gosmespinho da frente em 3 de Vida e concede +2 Espinhos."
trinket.banner_burnie.name,Banner: Burnie,Estandarte: Burnie
trinket.banner_burnie.desc,"Burnie's blazing vanguard. Grants the Fire Trait Crest for free, surrounding Burnie with synergized Fire units that spread Burn and explode when knocked out. Summons Fire reinforcements at odd turn ends.","A vanguarda flamejante de Burnie. Concede o Brasão de Fogo gratuitamente, cercando Burnie com unidades de Fogo sinérgicas que espalham Chamas e explodem quando são nocauteadas. Invoca reforços de Fogo no fim dos turnos ímpares."
ability.dustmon_spore.desc,"When an ally is knocked out, heals HP equal to their tier and adds a dust minion in the player's gacha machines.","Quando um aliado é nocauteado, cura uma quantidade de Vida igual ao Tier dele e adiciona um recruta de poeira às Máquinas Gacha do jogador."
ability.dustmon_merge.desc,"When dust minions merge, adds a dust minion in the player's gacha machines and gains 1 HP and 1 PWR.","Quando recrutas de poeira se fundem, adiciona um recruta de poeira nas máquinas de gacha do jogador e ganha 1 de Vida e 1 Poder."
ability.dustmon_vampiric.desc,"When an ally is knocked out, heals HP equal to the fallen ally's tier.","Quando um aliado é nocauteado, cura uma quantidade de Vida igual ao Tier do aliado nocauteado."
ability.dustmon_resonance.desc,Gains +1 PWR for every Dust unit in existence across all player containers.,Ganha +1 de Poder para cada unidade de Poeira existente em todos os recipientes do jogador.
ability.dust_enter_board.desc,"When entering a Lineup, gains 1 burn and 1 static.","Ao entrar na Formação, ganha 1 Chamas e 1 Estática."
ability.dust_t2_enter_board.desc,"When entering a Lineup, gains 2 burn and 2 static.","Ao entrar na Formação, ganha 2 Chamas e 2 Estática."
ability.dust_t3_enter_board.desc,"When entering a Lineup, gains 3 burn and 3 static.","Ao entrar na Formação, ganha 3 Chamas e 3 Estática."
ability.toughmon_command.desc,"At turn start, gains Armor for surviving allies and commands frontline allies with +2 Armor and +1 Spikes.","No início do turno, ganha Armadura para aliados vivos e concede +2 Armadura e +1 Espinhos aos aliados da frente."
ability.doppelkun_mirror.desc,"At pre-battle, mirrors the current HP and PWR of the enemy Hero.","No pré-batalha, espelha os valores atuais de Vida e Poder do Herói inimigo."
ability.slimeblob_mitosis.desc,"[color=#ffd166][b]When Taking Damage[/b][/color], if it is not knocked out, summons a Level 1 Spikeslime into the first empty slot.","[color=#ffd166][b]Ao Receber Dano[/b][/color], se não for nocauteada, invoca um Gosmespinho Nível 1 no primeiro espaço vazio."
ability.slimeblob_evolution.desc,"At turn start, summons a Level 1 Spikeslime into the first empty slot. If all slots are full, levels up the first non-max Spikeslime from front to back. If all Spikeslimes are max level, heals the front Spikeslime for 3 HP and grants it +2 Spikes.","No início do turno, invoca um Gosmespinho Nível 1 no primeiro espaço vazio. Se todos os espaços estiverem cheios, sobe o nível do primeiro Gosmespinho que não esteja no nível máximo da frente para trás. Se todos os Gosmespinhos estiverem no nível máximo, cura o Gosmespinho da frente em 3 de Vida e concede +2 Espinhos."
ability.burnie_attack.desc,Attacks deal bonus damage equal to target's Burn stacks and ignite the target's slot into a Burn slot.,Ataques causam dano adicional igual aos acúmulos de Chamas do alvo e incendeiam seu espaço no campo.
ability.banner_reinforce.desc,"At odd turn ends, calls in tactical wave reinforcements.","No final de turnos ímpares, chama reforços táticos."
trinket.banner_earth.name,Earth Banner,Estandarte de Terra
trinket.banner_earth.desc,"A resilient frontline uses healing to sustain Earth Armor and Spikes. Grants the Earth Crest for free. Approved off-trait partners receive free Earth Emblems. At odd turn ends, calls in reinforcements to repair its formation.","Uma linha de frente resistente usa cura para sustentar Armadura e Espinhos de Terra. Concede o Brasão de Terra gratuitamente. Parceiros aprovados de outros Tipos recebem Emblemas de Terra gratuitos. No fim dos turnos ímpares, chama reforços para recompor a Formação."
trinket.banner_water.name,Water Banner,Estandarte de Água
trinket.banner_water.desc,"Positional healing and cleansing sustain allies whose abilities activate when healed. Grants the Water Crest for free. Approved off-trait partners receive free Water Emblems. At odd turn ends, calls in reinforcements to repair its formation.","Cura e purificação posicionais sustentam aliados cujas habilidades são ativadas ao receber cura. Concede o Brasão de Água gratuitamente. Parceiros aprovados de outros Tipos recebem Emblemas de Água gratuitos. No fim dos turnos ímpares, chama reforços para recompor a Formação."
trinket.banner_air.name,Air Banner,Estandarte de Ar
trinket.banner_air.desc,"Directional PWR transfers and ranged pressure help knock out enemies carrying Static. Grants the Air Crest for free. Approved off-Trait partners receive free Air Emblems. At odd turn ends, calls in reinforcements to repair its formation.","Transferências direcionais de Poder e pressão à distância ajudam a nocautear inimigos com Estática. Concede o Brasão de Ar gratuitamente. Parceiros aprovados de outros Tipos recebem Emblemas de Ar gratuitos. No fim dos turnos ímpares, chama reforços para recompor a Formação."
trinket.banner_tank.name,Tank Banner,Estandarte de Guardião
trinket.banner_tank.desc,"Healing sustains an armored formation built around Armor passing and interception. Grants the Tank Crest for free. Approved off-trait partners receive free Tank Emblems. At odd turn ends, calls in reinforcements to repair its formation.","A cura sustenta uma Formação defensiva baseada em transferência de Armadura e interceptação. Concede o Brasão de Guardião gratuitamente. Parceiros aprovados de outros Tipos recebem Emblemas de Guardião gratuitos. No fim dos turnos ímpares, chama reforços para recompor a Formação."
trinket.banner_fighter.name,Fighter Banner,Estandarte de Lutador
trinket.banner_fighter.desc,"Knocked-out allies feed PWR and growth for aggressive Fighters. Grants the Fighter Crest for free. Approved off-Trait partners receive free Fighter Emblems. At odd turn ends, calls in reinforcements to repair its formation.","Aliados nocauteados fornecem Poder e fortalecem Lutadores agressivos. Concede o Brasão de Lutador gratuitamente. Parceiros aprovados de outros Tipos recebem Emblemas de Lutador gratuitos. No fim dos turnos ímpares, chama reforços para recompor a Formação."
trinket.banner_support.name,Support Banner,Estandarte de Suporte
trinket.banner_support.desc,"Positional stat buffs, summon support, and adjacent buff copying build a growing team. Grants the Support Crest for free. Approved off-trait partners receive free Support Emblems. At odd turn ends, calls in reinforcements to repair its formation.","Bônus posicionais, suporte a invocações e cópia de bônus adjacentes fortalecem a equipe. Concede o Brasão de Suporte gratuitamente. Parceiros aprovados de outros Tipos recebem Emblemas de Suporte gratuitos. No fim dos turnos ímpares, chama reforços para recompor a Formação."
trinket.banner_plant.name,Plant Banner,Estandarte de Planta
trinket.banner_plant.desc,"Repeated healing keeps a Plant frontline alive while it accumulates Spikes. Grants the Plant Crest for free. Approved off-trait partners receive free Plant Emblems. At odd turn ends, calls in reinforcements to repair its formation.","Curas repetidas mantêm a linha de frente de Plantas viva enquanto acumula Espinhos. Concede o Brasão de Planta gratuitamente. Parceiros aprovados de outros Tipos recebem Emblemas de Planta gratuitos. No fim dos turnos ímpares, chama reforços para recompor a Formação."
trinket.banner_food.name,Food Banner,Estandarte de Comida
trinket.banner_food.desc,"Hurt Food units heal the ally behind, activating healing abilities and feeding stat growth. Grants the Food Crest for free. Approved off-trait partners receive free Food Emblems. At odd turn ends, calls in reinforcements to repair its formation.","Unidades de Comida feridas curam o aliado atrás, ativando habilidades de cura e crescimento de atributos. Concede o Brasão de Comida gratuitamente. Parceiros aprovados de outros Tipos recebem Emblemas de Comida gratuitos. No fim dos turnos ímpares, chama reforços para recompor a Formação."
trinket.banner_animal.name,Animal Banner,Estandarte de Animal
trinket.banner_animal.desc,"Animal attack healing activates allied Armor, Spikes, or Burn abilities. Grants the Animal Crest for free. Approved off-trait partners receive free Animal Emblems. At odd turn ends, calls in reinforcements to repair its formation.","A cura dos ataques de Animais ativa habilidades de Armadura, Espinhos ou Chamas. Concede o Brasão de Animal gratuitamente. Parceiros aprovados de outros Tipos recebem Emblemas de Animal gratuitos. No fim dos turnos ímpares, chama reforços para recompor a Formação."
trinket.banner_mecha.name,Mecha Banner,Estandarte de Mecha
trinket.banner_mecha.desc,"Armored Mechas inflict Static and support an attrition engine of summons and revenge. Grants the Mecha Crest for free. Approved off-trait partners receive free Mecha Emblems. At odd turn ends, calls in reinforcements to repair its formation.","Mechas protegidos por Armadura aplicam Estática e sustentam uma estratégia de invocações e retaliação. Concede o Brasão de Mecha gratuitamente. Parceiros aprovados de outros Tipos recebem Emblemas de Mecha gratuitos. No fim dos turnos ímpares, chama reforços para recompor a Formação."
trinket.banner_toy.name,Toy Banner,Estandarte de Brinquedo

trinket.banner_appliance.name,Appliance Banner,Estandarte de Eletrodoméstico

trinket.banner_costume.name,Costume Banner,Estandarte de Fantasia
```

### File: `scripts/abilities/EffectScald.gd`
```gdscript
@tool
class_name EffectScald
extends EffectDefinition

func execute(source_uuid: String, targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var result := EffectResult.new()
	
	# Only trigger if the unit is in the lineup (Player or Enemy)
	# This prevents the ability from triggering when the unit is on the shelf.
	var source_unit = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(source_unit):
		return result
		
	var container_tag = source_unit.location_container_tag
	if container_tag != &"PlayerLineup" and container_tag != &"EnemyLineup":
		return result
	
	# Get heal amount from context
	var heal_amount: int = context.heal_amount
	if heal_amount <= 0:
		return result
		
	var extra_bounces: int = parameters.get("extra_bounces", 0)
	
	var is_player_team = (container_tag == &"PlayerLineup")
	var enemy_container = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP if is_player_team else C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP
	
	var current_source_uuid = source_uuid
	var current_target_uuid = ""
	
	# Initial random target
	var initial_enemies = battle_manager.get_instances_in_container(enemy_container).filter(func(u): return u.current_hp > 0)
	if initial_enemies.is_empty():
		return result
	current_target_uuid = RNGManager.combat_rng.pick_random(initial_enemies).ball_uuid
	
	var current_burn_amount = heal_amount
	
	for bounce_index in range(extra_bounces + 1):
		var target_inst = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(current_target_uuid)
		if not is_instance_valid(target_inst) or target_inst.current_hp <= 0:
			break # Stop bouncing if target is somehow invalid
			
		var old_burn = target_inst.get_status_effect_amount(&"burn")
		var new_burn = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(target_inst, "burn_stacks", current_burn_amount)
		
		var burn_event = CombatEvent.new(
			CombatEvent.Type.STATUS_EFFECT,
			{
				"target_uuids": [current_target_uuid],
				"is_simulation": context.is_simulation,
				"visual_payload": CombatPayload.status_change(current_source_uuid, current_burn_amount, "burn_stacks", [old_burn], [new_burn], Color.ORANGE_RED)
			}
		)
		result.events.append(burn_event)
		
		# Prepare next bounce
		if bounce_index < extra_bounces:
			current_source_uuid = current_target_uuid
			current_burn_amount = max(1, int(floor(current_burn_amount / 2.0)))
			
			var enemies = battle_manager.get_instances_in_container(enemy_container).filter(func(u): return u.current_hp > 0)
			if enemies.is_empty():
				break
				
			var possible_next_targets = enemies.filter(func(u): return u.ball_uuid != current_target_uuid)
			if possible_next_targets.is_empty():
				# Bounce back to same target if no one else is alive
				possible_next_targets = enemies
				
			var next_enemy = RNGManager.combat_rng.pick_random(possible_next_targets)
			current_target_uuid = next_enemy.ball_uuid
			
	return result
```

### File: `scripts/AbilitiesRegistry.gd`
```gdscript
# res://scripts/AbilitiesRegistry.gd
class_name AbilitiesRegistry
extends RefCounted

## Central source of truth for all abilities
## Use this file to understand what each ability does and how it triggers.
## This registry documents the complete ability system for easy reference.

## Trigger Types Reference:
## - on_attack: Unit performs its turn action attack (NOT retaliate/extra attack)
## - on_damage_dealt: After this unit deals attack damage (any source)
## - on_hurt: After this unit receives attack damage
## - on_before_damage: Before this unit receives attack damage
## - on_death: This unit dies
## - on_ally_death: A teammate dies (not self)
## - on_kill: This unit kills an enemy
## - on_turn_start: Turn begins
## - on_turn_end: Turn ends
## - on_battle_start: Battle begins
## - on_merge: A merge is completed on the battle board (lineup/shelf/equipped item)
## - passive_intercept: Special BattleManager-handled passive (e.g., Guardian)

## Get information about an ability
static func get_ability_info(ability_id: StringName) -> Dictionary:
	return ABILITIES.get(String(ability_id), {})

## Get a human-readable description of an ability
static func describe(ability_id: StringName) -> String:
	var info = get_ability_info(ability_id)
	if info.is_empty():
		return "Unknown ability: %s" % ability_id
	
	var trigger = info.get("trigger", "?")
	var effect = info.get("effect", "?")
	var condition = info.get("condition", null)
	
	var desc = "[%s] %s" % [trigger, effect]
	if condition:
		desc += " (if %s)" % condition
	return desc
```

### File: `scripts/AbilityDefinition.gd`
```gdscript
# res://scripts/AbilityDefinition.gd
@tool
class_name AbilityDefinition
extends Resource

## Where the unit (or equipped item's holder) must be to activate this ability.
## Trinkets remain team-wide listeners; their effects define their target scope.
enum ActivationScope { LINEUP, BATTLE_BOARD, PLAYER_SHELF, ANY_LOCATION }

@export var activation_scope: ActivationScope = ActivationScope.LINEUP

## The central "glue" resource that links a Trigger to one or more Effects, gated by an optional Condition.
## This is what is attached to a GachaBallDefinition's list of abilities.

## Unique identifier for the ability (e.g., "last_wish_cricket").
@export var id: StringName
## Retained for resource compatibility; ability titles are not displayed.
@export var name_key: String
## The specific gameplay event that can activate this ability (e.g., "when_knocked_out"). See TDD for canonical list.
@export var trigger: StringName = &""
## An optional resource. If present, this condition must be met for the ability to activate.
@export var condition: ConditionDefinition
## An array of one or more effects to execute when the ability is successfully triggered.
@export var effects: Array[EffectDefinition]
## The localization key for the ability's description text.
@export var description_key: String

## The minimum unit level required for this ability to be active.
@export var required_level: int = 1
## The maximum unit level for this ability to be active (use this to replace abilities at higher levels).
@export var max_level: int = 99

const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")
## Reaction resolution sub-phase. Lower numbers resolve first (ascending order).
## Default is STANDARD (200).
@export var sub_phase: C.SubPhase = C.SubPhase.STANDARD


## If true, triggering this ability during 'on_attack' will prevent the default Basic Attack from being enqueued.
@export var replaces_basic_attack: bool = false

## If true, this ability can still execute even if the source unit has taken knockout damage.
## Use for: Counter-attacks, Retaliation, Resilient Aura, etc.
## Default: false (ability is discarded if source is knocked out)
@export var execute_before_knockout: bool = false
```

### File: `scripts/AbilityResolver.gd`
```gdscript
# res://scripts/AbilityResolver.gd
extends Node

## A stateless service that acts as the central coordinator for the ability system.
## Its primary responsibility is to translate game events into EffectRequests.

const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

# =============================================================================
# UNIFIED FILTER SYSTEM
# These helpers centralize trigger-based filtering. BattleManager broadcasts
# ONE event per occurrence; these filters determine which instances respond.
# =============================================================================

## Determine team from instance's container location.
## @param instance: The GachaBallInstance to check
## @param battle_manager: Reference to BattleManager for container tags
## @return "PLAYER", "ENEMY", or "" if unknown
func _get_instance_team(instance: GachaBallInstance, battle_manager: Node) -> String:
	assert(is_instance_valid(instance), "AbilityResolver: instance must be valid")
	var container = instance.location_container_tag
	if container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP or container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF:
		return "PLAYER"
	elif container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP or container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_SHELF:
		return "ENEMY"
	elif container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_TRINKETS:
		return "PLAYER"
	elif container in [C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_TRINKETS, C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_BANNER]:
		return "ENEMY"
	elif not instance.equipped_on_uuid.is_empty() and battle_manager != null and battle_manager.has_method("get_instance_by_uuid"):
		var parent_unit = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(instance.equipped_on_uuid)
		if is_instance_valid(parent_unit):
			return _get_instance_team(parent_unit, battle_manager)
	return ""

## Unified filter: Should this unit respond to this trigger?
## Called once per unit per trigger broadcast.
## @param trigger: The trigger type being processed
## @param unit_uuid: UUID of the unit being checked
## @param unit: The GachaBallInstance
## @param context: Trigger context with semantic keys
## @param battle_manager: Reference to BattleManager
## @return true if this unit should process abilities for this trigger
func _should_unit_respond(trigger: StringName, unit_uuid: String, unit: GachaBallInstance,
						  context: TriggerContext, battle_manager: Node) -> bool:
	match trigger:
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_ALLY_KNOCKED_OUT:
			# Unit must be: same team as fainting, alive, not the fainting unit
			var fainting_uuid = context.ally_knocked_out_uuid
			var fainting_team = context.ally_knocked_out_team
			var unit_team = _get_instance_team(unit, battle_manager)
			return unit_team == fainting_team and unit_uuid != fainting_uuid and unit.current_hp > 0
		
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_TAKING_DAMAGE:
			# Only the unit that received damage responds
			return unit_uuid == context.damaged_uuid
		
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_KNOCKED_OUT, C.TRIGGER_BEFORE_BEING_KNOCKED_OUT, C.TRIGGER_PREVENT_KNOCKOUT:
			# Only the affected unit responds (allowing current_hp <= 0)
			var target_uuid = context.knocked_out_uuid if not context.knocked_out_uuid.is_empty() else context.damaged_uuid
			return unit_uuid == target_uuid
		
		C.TRIGGER_INTERCEPT_ATTACK:
			# Only the intercepting guardian responds
			return unit_uuid == context.source_uuid
		
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_ATTACKING, C.TRIGGER_ON_KNOCKOUT_BLOW, C.TRIGGER_ON_DAMAGE_DEALT:
			# Only the attacker responds
			return unit_uuid == context.attacker_uuid
		
		C.TRIGGER_BEFORE_TAKING_DAMAGE:
			# Only the unit about to receive attack damage responds
			return unit_uuid == context.defender_uuid
		
		C.TRIGGER_AT_TURN_START, C.TRIGGER_AT_TURN_END, C.TRIGGER_AT_BATTLE_START, C.TRIGGER_ON_BOARD_STATE_CHANGED, C.TRIGGER_PRE_COMBAT:
			# All living units ON THE BATTLE BOARD respond
			return unit.current_hp > 0 and _is_on_battle_board(unit)
		
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_ENEMY_SUMMONED:
			# Only units on the OPPOSING team of the summoned unit respond
			var summoned_team = context.summoned_team
			var unit_team = _get_instance_team(unit, battle_manager)
			# Unit must be alive, on the board, and on the opposite team
			return unit.current_hp > 0 and _is_on_battle_board(unit) and unit_team != "" and unit_team != summoned_team
		
		C.TRIGGER_ON_ENTER_BOARD:
			# Only the unit that just entered the board responds
			return unit_uuid == context.entered_uuid
		
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_ALLY_SUMMONED:
			# Only units on the SAME team as the summoned unit respond
			var summoned_team = context.summoned_team
			var unit_team = _get_instance_team(unit, battle_manager)
			# Unit must be alive, on the board, on the same team, and NOT the summoned unit itself
			var summoned_uuid = context.summoned_uuid
			return unit.current_hp > 0 and _is_on_battle_board(unit) and unit_team != "" and unit_team == summoned_team and unit_uuid != summoned_uuid

		C.TRIGGER_ON_MERGE:
			# Only living units already on battle board (lineup/shelf) can respond.
			if unit.current_hp <= 0 or not _is_on_battle_board(unit):
				return false

			# If merge context has a team, only that side responds (Knight-style team scoping).
			var merged_team: String = context.merged_team
			if merged_team.is_empty():
				return true

			var unit_container: StringName = unit.location_container_tag
			var unit_team_on_board: String = ""
			if unit_container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP or unit_container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF:
				unit_team_on_board = "PLAYER"
			elif unit_container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP or unit_container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_SHELF:
				unit_team_on_board = "ENEMY"
			return unit_team_on_board == merged_team
		
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_DUST_MINIONS_MERGE:
			return unit.current_hp > 0 and _is_on_battle_board(unit)

		C.TRIGGER_ON_GACHA_DRAW:
			# Enemy units respond to player draws (draws benefit enemies)
			# AND the drawn unit itself responds (for initialization effects like Merchant)
			var unit_team = _get_instance_team(unit, battle_manager)
			var drawn_uuid = context.drawn_uuid
			
			if unit_uuid == drawn_uuid:
				return true # Self-trigger
				
			return unit.current_hp > 0 and _is_on_battle_board(unit) and unit_team == "ENEMY"
		
		C.TRIGGER_ON_TOKEN_SPENT:
			# Only enemy units respond to player token spending
			var unit_team = _get_instance_team(unit, battle_manager)
			return unit.current_hp > 0 and _is_on_battle_board(unit) and unit_team == "ENEMY"
		
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_ALLY_TAKES_DAMAGE:
			# Teammates of the hurt unit respond (not the hurt unit itself)
			var damaged_unit_uuid = context.damaged_uuid
			var victim_team = context.damaged_team
			var unit_team = _get_instance_team(unit, battle_manager)
			# Must be alive, same team as victim, not the victim itself
			return unit.current_hp > 0 and unit_team == victim_team and unit_uuid != damaged_unit_uuid
		
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_HEALED:
			# Only the healed unit itself responds to its own healing
			var healed_uuid = context.healed_uuid if not context.healed_uuid.is_empty() else context.unit_uuid
			return unit.current_hp > 0 and unit_uuid == healed_uuid
		
		C.TRIGGER_ON_GACHA_TOKENS_CHANGED:
			# All living units respond to token changes
			return unit.current_hp > 0 and _is_on_battle_board(unit)
			
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_ANY_UNIT_KNOCKED_OUT:
			# All living units respond to any unit death
			return unit.current_hp > 0 and _is_on_battle_board(unit)
			
		C.TRIGGER_ON_GOLD_EARNED, C.TRIGGER_ON_GOLD_SPENT, C.TRIGGER_AT_MINIGAME_END, C.TRIGGER_BEFORE_MINIGAME:
			# Living units respond if in active lineup (AMer does not trigger while shelved)
			var container: StringName = unit.location_container_tag
			return unit.current_hp > 0 and (
				container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP or
				container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP
			)
			
		C.TRIGGER_ON_STAT_INCREASED, C.TRIGGER_ON_STAT_DECREASED:
			# Units respond if they are on the battle board and alive
			# Loop Prevention: Do not respond if this unit caused the stat modification
			var target_uuid = context.unit_uuid
			var source_uuid = context.source_uuid
			
			if unit.current_hp <= 0 or not _is_on_battle_board(unit):
				return false
				
			if not source_uuid.is_empty() and unit_uuid == source_uuid:
				return false
				
			# The unit whose stat changed always responds (self-trigger)
			if unit_uuid == target_uuid:
				return true
				
			# Living allies on the same team also respond (e.g. team reaction abilities)
			var target_inst = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(target_uuid)
			if is_instance_valid(target_inst):
				var target_team = _get_instance_team(target_inst, battle_manager)
				var unit_team = _get_instance_team(unit, battle_manager)
				return unit_team == target_team
				
			return false
	
	# Default: respond (for any new triggers)
	return true

## Determine if a unit is on the battle board (lineup or shelf)
func _is_on_battle_board(unit: GachaBallInstance) -> bool:
	if not is_instance_valid(unit):
		return false
	var container: StringName = unit.location_container_tag
	return (
		container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP
		or container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF
		or container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP
		or container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_SHELF
	)

## Unified filter: Should this equipped item respond to this trigger?
## @param trigger: The trigger type being processed
## @param item: The equipped item instance
## @param context: Trigger context with semantic keys
## @return true if this item should process abilities for this trigger
func _should_item_respond(trigger: StringName, item: GachaBallInstance, context: TriggerContext) -> bool:
	# Items can always respond to on_board_state_changed to update their passive stats, even on the shelf
	if trigger == C.TRIGGER_ON_BOARD_STATE_CHANGED:
		return true

	var holder_uuid = item.equipped_on_uuid
	assert(not holder_uuid.is_empty(), "AbilityResolver: item must be equipped to respond to combat triggers")
	
	match trigger:
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_TAKING_DAMAGE:
			return holder_uuid == context.damaged_uuid
		
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_KNOCKED_OUT, C.TRIGGER_BEFORE_BEING_KNOCKED_OUT, C.TRIGGER_PREVENT_KNOCKOUT:
			var target_uuid = context.knocked_out_uuid if not context.knocked_out_uuid.is_empty() else context.damaged_uuid
			return holder_uuid == target_uuid
		
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_ATTACKING, C.TRIGGER_ON_KNOCKOUT_BLOW, C.TRIGGER_ON_DAMAGE_DEALT:
			return holder_uuid == context.attacker_uuid
		
		C.TRIGGER_BEFORE_TAKING_DAMAGE:
			return holder_uuid == context.defender_uuid
		
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_ALLY_KNOCKED_OUT:
			# Items on living allies respond (not on the dying unit)
			var fainting_uuid = context.ally_knocked_out_uuid
			return holder_uuid != fainting_uuid
		
		C.TRIGGER_AT_TURN_START, C.TRIGGER_AT_TURN_END, C.TRIGGER_AT_BATTLE_START, C.TRIGGER_ON_BOARD_STATE_CHANGED, C.TRIGGER_PRE_COMBAT, C.TRIGGER_ON_GOLD_EARNED, C.TRIGGER_ON_GOLD_SPENT, C.TRIGGER_AT_MINIGAME_END, C.TRIGGER_BEFORE_MINIGAME:
			# All equipped items on living holders respond
			return true
		
		C.TRIGGER_ON_GACHA_DRAW:
			# Items don't respond to on_draw - only trinkets do
			return false
		
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_HEALED:
			var healed_uuid = context.healed_uuid if not context.healed_uuid.is_empty() else context.unit_uuid
			return holder_uuid == healed_uuid
		
		C.TRIGGER_ON_STAT_INCREASED, C.TRIGGER_ON_STAT_DECREASED:
			var target_uuid = context.unit_uuid
			return holder_uuid == target_uuid
	
	return true

## Unified filter: Should this trinket respond to this trigger?
## @param trigger: The trigger type being processed
## @param trinket: The trinket instance
## @param context: Trigger context with semantic keys
## @param battle_manager: Reference to BattleManager
## @return true if this trinket should process abilities for this trigger
func _should_trinket_respond(trigger: StringName, trinket: GachaBallInstance,
							 context: TriggerContext, battle_manager: Node) -> bool:
	var trinket_team = _get_instance_team(trinket, battle_manager)
	var trinket_def = trinket.get_definition()
	var trinket_name = trinket_def.name_key if is_instance_valid(trinket_def) else "Unknown"
	
	match trigger:
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_ALLY_KNOCKED_OUT:
			# Trinkets only respond to deaths on their own team
			var fainting_team = context.ally_knocked_out_team
			return trinket_team == fainting_team
		
		C.TRIGGER_PREVENT_KNOCKOUT:
			var target_team = context.damaged_team
			return trinket_team == target_team
		
		C.TRIGGER_AT_TURN_START, C.TRIGGER_AT_TURN_END, C.TRIGGER_AT_BATTLE_START, C.TRIGGER_ON_BOARD_STATE_CHANGED, C.TRIGGER_PRE_COMBAT, C.TRIGGER_ON_GOLD_EARNED, C.TRIGGER_ON_GOLD_SPENT, C.TRIGGER_AT_MINIGAME_END, C.TRIGGER_BEFORE_MINIGAME:
			# All trinkets respond
			return true
		
		C.TRIGGER_ON_GACHA_DRAW:
			# Only player trinkets respond to player draws
			# (enemies don't draw, so this is always player team for now)
			return trinket_team == "PLAYER"
		
		C.TRIGGER_ON_MERGE:
			# Trinkets only respond to merges on their own team
			var merged_team = context.merged_team
			return trinket_team == merged_team
		
		C.TRIGGER_WHEN_ALLY_SUMMONED:
			# Trinkets only respond to ally summons on their own team
			var summoned_team = context.summoned_team
			return trinket_team == summoned_team
		
		C.TRIGGER_ON_STAT_INCREASED, C.TRIGGER_ON_STAT_DECREASED:
			var target_uuid = context.unit_uuid
			var target_inst = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(target_uuid)
			if is_instance_valid(target_inst):
				return trinket_team == _get_instance_team(target_inst, battle_manager)
			return true
	
	# For other triggers, trinkets respond based on team context if available
	return true

# =============================================================================
# MAIN TRIGGER PROCESSING
# =============================================================================

## Process a trigger event and generate EffectRequests for all matching abilities.
##
## UNIFIED BROADCAST PATTERN: BattleManager calls this ONCE per event.
## AbilityResolver self-filters to determine which instances respond.
##
## Ordering contract (docs/AbilitySystem.md):
## 1) Units first
## 2) Equipped Items second (sorted by slot index)
## 3) Trinkets last
##
## @param trigger: StringName - The trigger type (e.g., "on_attack", "on_death")
## @param context: TriggerContext - The context with semantic properties (e.g., damaged_uuid, attacker_uuid)
func process_trigger(trigger: StringName, context: TriggerContext = null) -> void:
	if context == null:
		context = TriggerContext.new()
	# Add trigger_type to context so it flows through to CombatEvents
	context.trigger_type = trigger
	if is_instance_valid(GameManager.run_state):
		context.gold_tens = int(GameManager.run_state.gold / 10)
	else:
		context.gold_tens = 0
	
	# Get the current BattleManager
	var battle_manager = GameManager.get_battle_manager()
	if not is_instance_valid(battle_manager):
		battle_manager = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")
	assert(is_instance_valid(battle_manager), "AbilityResolver: BattleManager not found")

	# Optimization: Single pass to bucket all instances by category
	var all_instances = battle_manager.get_all_instances()
	
	var unit_instances: Array[Dictionary] = []
	var equipped_item_instances: Array[Dictionary] = []
	var trinket_instances: Array[Dictionary] = []

	for instance_uuid in all_instances:
		var instance = all_instances.get(instance_uuid)
		if not is_instance_valid(instance):
			continue
		var definition = instance.get_definition()
		if not is_instance_valid(definition) or not ("category" in definition):
			continue

		if definition.category == &"UNIT":
			unit_instances.append({"uuid": instance_uuid, "inst": instance, "def": definition})
		elif definition.category == &"ITEM":
			# Skip unequipped items unless it's a passive stat update trigger
			if instance.equipped_on_uuid.is_empty() and trigger != C.TRIGGER_ON_BOARD_STATE_CHANGED:
				continue
				
			# Use unified filter to check if item should respond
			if not _should_item_respond(trigger, instance, context):
				continue
			# Check if item has matching ability for this trigger
			var has_matching = false
			for entry in instance.get_active_ability_entries(all_instances):
				var ability: AbilityDefinition = entry.get("ability_def")
				if not is_instance_valid(ability):
					continue
				if ability.trigger == trigger:
					has_matching = true
					break
			if has_matching:
				equipped_item_instances.append({
					"instance_uuid": instance_uuid,
					"instance": instance,
					"definition": definition,
					"slot_index": instance.equipped_slot_index
				})
		elif definition.category == &"TRINKET":
			trinket_instances.append({"uuid": instance_uuid, "inst": instance, "def": definition})

	# Phase 1: Process unit abilities
	for data in unit_instances:
		var instance_uuid: String = data.uuid
		var instance: GachaBallInstance = data.inst
		var definition = data.def
		
		# Use unified filter
		if not _should_unit_respond(trigger, instance_uuid, instance, context, battle_manager):
			continue

		# Process all abilities from the component system (definition + injected + persistent)
		for entry in instance.get_active_ability_entries(all_instances):
			if entry.get("source_type") == &"EQUIPMENT":
				continue
			var ability: AbilityDefinition = entry.get("ability_def")
			if not is_instance_valid(ability):
				continue
			if ability.trigger == trigger or (ability.trigger == C.TRIGGER_ON_GACHA_TOKENS_CHANGED and (trigger == C.TRIGGER_ON_ENTER_BOARD or trigger == C.TRIGGER_ON_BOARD_STATE_CHANGED)):
				_process_ability(ability, entry.get("source_instance_uuid", instance_uuid), battle_manager, context)


	# Phase 2: Process equipped item abilities (sorted by slot for deterministic order)
	equipped_item_instances.sort_custom(func(a, b): return a.slot_index < b.slot_index)
	
	for item_data in equipped_item_instances:
		var instance_uuid: String = item_data.instance_uuid
		var item_instance: GachaBallInstance = item_data.instance

		for entry in item_instance.get_active_ability_entries(all_instances):
			var ability: AbilityDefinition = entry.get("ability_def")
			if not is_instance_valid(ability):
				continue
			if ability.trigger == trigger:
				_process_ability(ability, entry.get("source_instance_uuid", instance_uuid), battle_manager, context)

	# Phase 3: Process trinket abilities
	for data in trinket_instances:
		var instance_uuid: String = data.uuid
		var instance: GachaBallInstance = data.inst
		var definition = data.def
		
		# Use unified filter
		if not _should_trinket_respond(trigger, instance, context, battle_manager):
			continue
		
		# Add trinket's team to context for effects that need it
		var trinket_team = _get_instance_team(instance, battle_manager)
		var trinket_context: TriggerContext = context.duplicate_context()
		trinket_context.team = trinket_team
		
		for entry in instance.get_active_ability_entries(all_instances):
			var ability: AbilityDefinition = entry.get("ability_def")
			if not is_instance_valid(ability):
				continue
			if ability.trigger == trigger:
				# Trinkets are team-based, not unit-based. The trinket itself is the source.
				# This avoids dead-unit edge cases and is semantically correct.
				_process_ability(ability, entry.get("source_instance_uuid", instance_uuid), battle_manager, trinket_context)


## Process a single ability and create EffectRequests for its effects.
## @param source_uuid: String - The UUID of the source instance
## @param battle_manager: Node - The current battle manager
func _process_ability(ability: AbilityDefinition, source_uuid: String, battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> void:
	var source: GachaBallInstance = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	assert(source != null, "AbilityResolver: ability source must be registered: %s" % source_uuid)
	if not _is_ability_source_active(ability, source, battle_manager):
		return
	# Only units have HP; their own knockout and lethal reactions remain eligible.
	var definition: Resource = source.get_definition()
	if definition.category == C.CATEGORY_UNIT and source.current_hp <= 0:
		var is_own_death_trigger: bool = context.knocked_out_uuid == source_uuid
		if not is_own_death_trigger and not ability.execute_before_knockout:
			return
	
	# Check condition if present
	if is_instance_valid(ability.condition):
		var condition_result = battle_manager.check_condition(ability.condition, source_uuid, context)
		if not condition_result:
			return # Condition failed, skip this ability
	
	var category: StringName = &""
	var is_player: bool = false
	var slot_index: int = -1
	var sub_index: int = 0
	if is_instance_valid(source):
		var source_def = source.get_definition()
		if is_instance_valid(source_def) and ("category" in source_def):
			category = source_def.category
		if battle_manager.has_method("_is_player_owned"):
			is_player = battle_manager._is_player_owned(source)
		elif battle_manager.has_method("_is_player_unit"):
			is_player = battle_manager._is_player_unit(source)
		
		if not source.equipped_on_uuid.is_empty():
			var holder = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source.equipped_on_uuid)
			if is_instance_valid(holder):
				slot_index = holder.location_slot_index
				if battle_manager.has_method("_is_player_owned"):
					is_player = battle_manager._is_player_owned(holder)
			sub_index = source.equipped_slot_index
		else:
			slot_index = source.location_slot_index
	
	var ability_activated := false
	
	# Process each effect in the ability
	for effect in ability.effects:
		if not is_instance_valid(effect):
			continue
		
		# Resolve targets for this effect
		var resolved_targets: Array[String] = battle_manager.resolve_target(source_uuid, effect.target_type, context)
		
		# If we found valid targets, mark ability as activated
		if not resolved_targets.is_empty():
			ability_activated = true
		
		# Create EffectRequest
		# For counter-attack abilities, mark the context to identify counter-attack effects
		var effect_context: TriggerContext = context.duplicate_context()
		if ability.replaces_basic_attack:
			effect_context.on_attack_already_triggered = true
		if ability.id.contains("counter"):
			effect_context.is_counter = true
		
		var effect_request = EffectRequest.new(
			source_uuid,
			ability.id,
			effect,
			resolved_targets,
			effect_context,
			ability.sub_phase,
			category,
			is_player,
			slot_index,
			sub_index
		)
		
		# Enqueue the request
		battle_manager.enqueue_effect_request(effect_request)

	# If ability successfully activated (found targets) AND it replaces basic attack, set flag
	# This ensures we fallback to basic attack if the special ability fails to find a target (e.g. empty mirror slot)
	if ability_activated and ability.replaces_basic_attack and context.trigger_type == C.TRIGGER_WHEN_ATTACKING:
		context.attack_replaced = true

## Apply location eligibility per ability, so passive stat updates do not enable
## the same unit's combat abilities or the holder's other equipment triggers.
func _is_ability_source_active(ability: AbilityDefinition, source: GachaBallInstance, battle_manager: Node) -> bool:
	var definition: Resource = source.get_definition()
	if definition is TrinketDefinition or definition.category == C.CATEGORY_CONSUMABLE:
		return true
	var holder: GachaBallInstance = source
	if definition.category == C.CATEGORY_ITEM:
		if source.equipped_on_uuid.is_empty():
			return ability.activation_scope == AbilityDefinition.ActivationScope.ANY_LOCATION
		holder = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source.equipped_on_uuid)
		assert(holder != null, "AbilityResolver: equipped item holder must be registered")

	var container: StringName = holder.location_container_tag
	# Sealed Shelf residents are inert except for the explicit Shelf growth ability.
	if container in [C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF, C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_SHELF] and ability.activation_scope != AbilityDefinition.ActivationScope.PLAYER_SHELF:
		return false
	if ability.activation_scope == AbilityDefinition.ActivationScope.ANY_LOCATION:
		return true
	var player_shelf_slot_is_unlocked: bool = true
	if container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF:
		var typed_battle_manager: BattleManager = battle_manager as BattleManager
		player_shelf_slot_is_unlocked = typed_battle_manager._state.is_player_shelf_slot_unlocked(holder.location_slot_index)
	match ability.activation_scope:
		AbilityDefinition.ActivationScope.LINEUP:
			return container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP or container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP
		AbilityDefinition.ActivationScope.BATTLE_BOARD:
			return container in [C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP, C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP]
		AbilityDefinition.ActivationScope.PLAYER_SHELF:
			return holder.current_hp > 0 and container == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF and player_shelf_slot_is_unlocked
	assert(false, "AbilityResolver: unsupported activation scope")
	return false
```

```gdscript
# scripts/animations/AnimationCompletionTracker.gd
class_name AnimationCompletionTracker
extends RefCounted

## A lightweight helper that tracks pending animation completions.
## Provides an async await_completion(uuid, type) API that resolves when
## the corresponding signal is emitted from SignalBus.

# Animation types that can be tracked
enum AnimationType {
	FLASH,
	COLOR_FLASH,
	BUMP,
	DEATH_FADE,
	SUMMON_FADE,
	MELEE_LUNGE,
	MELEE_RETURN,
	PREVENT_KNOCKOUT,
	MOVE, # Composable movement effect
	DEFORM # Composable sprite deformation effect
}

# Default timeout durations per animation type (seconds)
const TIMEOUTS: Dictionary = {
	AnimationType.FLASH: 0.8,
	AnimationType.COLOR_FLASH: 0.8,
	AnimationType.BUMP: 0.8,
	AnimationType.DEATH_FADE: 1.4,
	AnimationType.SUMMON_FADE: 1.5,
	AnimationType.MELEE_LUNGE: 1.0,
	AnimationType.MELEE_RETURN: 0.6,
	AnimationType.PREVENT_KNOCKOUT: 1.8,
	AnimationType.MOVE: 0.6, # Movement effects are quick
	AnimationType.DEFORM: 0.8 # Sprite deformation effects are quick
}

# Pending completions: Key = uuid, Value = Array of AnimationType still awaiting
var _pending: Dictionary = {}

# Scene tree reference for timers
var _tree: SceneTree

func _init(tree: SceneTree) -> void:
	_tree = tree
	_connect_signals()

func _connect_signals() -> void:
	# Connect once to all animation completion signals
	if SignalBus.unit_flash_finished.is_connected(_on_flash_finished):
		return # Already connected
	
	SignalBus.unit_flash_finished.connect(_on_flash_finished)
	if SignalBus.has_signal("unit_color_flash_finished"):
		SignalBus.unit_color_flash_finished.connect(_on_color_flash_finished)
	SignalBus.unit_bump_finished.connect(_on_bump_finished)
	SignalBus.unit_death_fade_finished.connect(_on_death_fade_finished)
	SignalBus.unit_summon_fade_finished.connect(_on_summon_fade_finished)
	SignalBus.unit_melee_lunge_finished.connect(_on_melee_lunge_finished)
	SignalBus.unit_melee_return_finished.connect(_on_melee_return_finished)
	SignalBus.unit_lethal_save_finished.connect(_on_lethal_save_finished)
	SignalBus.unit_move_finished.connect(_on_move_finished)
	SignalBus.unit_deform_finished.connect(_on_deform_finished)

## Await completion of a specific animation for a specific unit.
## Returns immediately if not pending. Times out gracefully.
func await_completion(uuid: String, anim_type: AnimationType) -> void:
	# Register this as pending
	if not _pending.has(uuid):
		_pending[uuid] = []
	_pending[uuid].append(anim_type)
	
	# Get timeout duration scaled by combat speed factor
	var timeout_duration: float = TIMEOUTS.get(anim_type, 0.5)
	var timeout_timer = AnimationConstants.create_pausable_timer(_tree, AnimationConstants.scaled(timeout_duration))
	
	# Poll until complete or timeout
	while _is_pending(uuid, anim_type) and timeout_timer.time_left > 0:
		await _tree.process_frame
	
	# If timed out, remove anyway
	if _is_pending(uuid, anim_type):
		_remove_pending(uuid, anim_type)

## Await several composable animation channels together so faster channels cannot
## finish before their completion handlers have been registered.
func await_completions(uuid: String, anim_types: Array[AnimationType]) -> void:
	assert(not uuid.is_empty(), "AnimationCompletionTracker.await_completions requires a unit UUID")
	assert(not anim_types.is_empty(), "AnimationCompletionTracker.await_completions requires at least one animation type")

	if not _pending.has(uuid):
		_pending[uuid] = []
	for anim_type in anim_types:
		_pending[uuid].append(anim_type)

	var timeout_duration: float = 0.0
	for anim_type in anim_types:
		timeout_duration = maxf(timeout_duration, float(TIMEOUTS[anim_type]))
	var timeout_timer: SceneTreeTimer = AnimationConstants.create_pausable_timer(_tree, AnimationConstants.scaled(timeout_duration))

	while _has_any_pending(uuid, anim_types) and timeout_timer.time_left > 0.0:
		await _tree.process_frame

	for anim_type in anim_types:
		if _is_pending(uuid, anim_type):
			_remove_pending(uuid, anim_type)

func _has_any_pending(uuid: String, anim_types: Array[AnimationType]) -> bool:
	for anim_type in anim_types:
		if _is_pending(uuid, anim_type):
			return true
	return false

## Check if a specific animation is still pending
func _is_pending(uuid: String, anim_type: AnimationType) -> bool:
	if not _pending.has(uuid):
		return false
	return anim_type in _pending[uuid]

## Mark animation as complete (remove from pending)
func _remove_pending(uuid: String, anim_type: AnimationType) -> void:
	if _pending.has(uuid):
		_pending[uuid].erase(anim_type)
		if _pending[uuid].is_empty():
			_pending.erase(uuid)

# Signal handlers - route to common handler
func _on_flash_finished(uuid: String) -> void:
	_remove_pending(uuid, AnimationType.FLASH)
	_remove_pending(uuid, AnimationType.COLOR_FLASH)

func _on_color_flash_finished(uuid: String) -> void:
	_remove_pending(uuid, AnimationType.COLOR_FLASH)
	_remove_pending(uuid, AnimationType.FLASH)

func _on_bump_finished(uuid: String) -> void:
	_remove_pending(uuid, AnimationType.BUMP)

func _on_death_fade_finished(uuid: String) -> void:
	_remove_pending(uuid, AnimationType.DEATH_FADE)

func _on_summon_fade_finished(uuid: String) -> void:
	_remove_pending(uuid, AnimationType.SUMMON_FADE)

func _on_melee_lunge_finished(uuid: String) -> void:
	_remove_pending(uuid, AnimationType.MELEE_LUNGE)

func _on_melee_return_finished(uuid: String) -> void:
	_remove_pending(uuid, AnimationType.MELEE_RETURN)

func _on_lethal_save_finished(uuid: String) -> void:
	_remove_pending(uuid, AnimationType.PREVENT_KNOCKOUT)

func _on_move_finished(uuid: String) -> void:
	_remove_pending(uuid, AnimationType.MOVE)

func _on_deform_finished(uuid: String) -> void:
	_remove_pending(uuid, AnimationType.DEFORM)

# Placeholder for early connection check
func _on_animation_finished(_uuid: String) -> void:
	pass
```

```gdscript
# scripts/animations/AnimationConstants.gd
class_name AnimationConstants
extends RefCounted

# --- PLAYBACK SPEED ---
# SAP-style speed factor. All animation durations are divided by this.
# 1.0 = normal, 3.0 = 3x speed
static var speed_factor: float = 1.0
static var is_in_battle: bool = false

## Get a duration scaled by the current speed factor.
## When in battle, durations are scaled by speed_factor. Outside battle, returns raw duration.
static func scaled(duration: float) -> float:
	if is_in_battle:
		return duration / maxf(speed_factor, 0.001)
	return duration

## Get the active speed multiplier (1.0 outside battle, speed_factor in battle).
static func get_effective_speed_factor() -> float:
	if is_in_battle:
		return maxf(speed_factor, 0.001)
	return 1.0

## Creates a timer that respects the game's pause state.
## All combat and management animations should use this instead of tree.create_timer directly
## to ensure the VCR freezes correctly when the player inspects a unit.
static func create_pausable_timer(tree: SceneTree, duration: float) -> SceneTreeTimer:
	return tree.create_timer(duration, false)


# =============================================================================
# MELEE ATTACK ANIMATION
# =============================================================================
# Total duration: WINDUP + LUNGE + RETURN = 0.1 + 0.6 + 0.3 = 1.0s
const MELEE_LUNGE_DURATION := 0.6 # Travel to target (2x return time)
const MELEE_WINDUP_DURATION := 0.1 # Anticipation before lunge
const MELEE_RETURN_DURATION := 0.3 # Return time (half of travel time)
const MELEE_ARC_HEIGHT := 120.0 # Arc height for the jump
const MELEE_WINDUP_DISTANCE := 30.0 # Pixels to wind back before lunge

# =============================================================================
# GUARDIAN SENTINEL LEAP
# =============================================================================
const GUARDIAN_LEAP_DURATION := 0.25 # Quick leap to ally's position
const GUARDIAN_RETURN_DURATION := 0.35 # Slightly slower return
const GUARDIAN_ARC_HEIGHT := 60.0 # Arc height for the leap

# =============================================================================
# BUMP ATTACK (Small knock-back animation)
# =============================================================================
const BUMP_DISTANCE := 10.0 # Pixels to bump forward
const BUMP_FORWARD_DURATION := 0.15 # Move forward time
const BUMP_RETURN_DURATION := 0.15 # Return time
const BUMP_TOTAL_DURATION := 0.5 # Total bump animation including settle time

# =============================================================================

## Appends the standard 4-phase landing bounce animation to any Tween targeting a Control or CanvasItem.
## Canonical bounce for any action that places a unit/item on a slot (land in shelf, move/place, swap, summon, merge).
static func append_landing_bounce(tween: Tween, target: CanvasItem, original_scale: Vector2 = Vector2.ONE) -> void:
	tween.tween_property(target, "scale", Vector2(1.2, 0.8), scaled(0.06)).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(target, "scale", Vector2(0.9, 1.15), scaled(0.1)).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(target, "scale", Vector2(1.05, 0.95), scaled(0.08)).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(target, "scale", original_scale, scaled(0.1)).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_ELASTIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
```
