```gdscript
# res://scripts/battle/BattleSetup.gd
class_name BattleSetup
extends RefCounted

## BattleSetup encapsulates battle initialization logic.

const RS = preload("res://scripts/RunState.gd")
const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

# ============================================================================
# HELPER UTILITIES
# ============================================================================

static func is_hero_definition(def: Resource) -> bool:
	if not is_instance_valid(def):
		return false
	if not def is GachaBallDefinition:
		return false
	var gbd := def as GachaBallDefinition
	if gbd.is_hero:
		return true
	var id_str = String(gbd.id).to_lower()
	if id_str == "hero" or id_str.begins_with("hero_"):
		return true
	if gbd.tags.has(&"hero"):
		return true
	return false

static func is_trinket_definition(def: Resource) -> bool:
	if not is_instance_valid(def):
		return false
	return def is TrinketDefinition or def.get("category") == &"TRINKET"

static func is_unit_definition(def: Resource) -> bool:
	if not is_instance_valid(def):
		return false
	if not def is GachaBallDefinition:
		return false
	return (def as GachaBallDefinition).category == &"UNIT"

# ============================================================================
# SETUP FROM RUN STATE
# ============================================================================

static func get_ordered_run_state_instances() -> Array[GachaBallInstance]:
	var result: Array[GachaBallInstance] = []
	var seen: Dictionary = {}
	if not is_instance_valid(GameManager.run_state):
		return result
		
	var containers_to_check: Array[StringName] = [
		RunState.RUN_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP,
		RunState.RUN_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF,
		&"RunInventoryT1",
		&"RunInventoryT2",
		&"RunInventoryT3",
		RunState.RUN_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_TRINKETS
	]
	
	for cname in containers_to_check:
		var container = GameManager.run_state.get_container(cname)
		if is_instance_valid(container):
			for uuid in container.get_all_uuids():
				if not uuid.is_empty() and not seen.has(uuid):
					var inst = GameManager.run_state.get_instance_by_uuid(uuid)
					if is_instance_valid(inst):
						result.append(inst)
						seen[uuid] = true
						for eq_uuid in inst.equipped_item_uuids:
							if not eq_uuid.is_empty() and not seen.has(eq_uuid):
								var eq_inst = GameManager.run_state.get_instance_by_uuid(eq_uuid)
								if is_instance_valid(eq_inst):
									result.append(eq_inst)
									seen[eq_uuid] = true
									
	var all_insts: Dictionary = GameManager.run_state.get_all_instances()
	for uuid in all_insts.keys():
		if not seen.has(uuid):
			var inst = all_insts[uuid]
			var def_id = inst.definition_id if is_instance_valid(inst) else "unknown"
			push_warning("BattleSetup: ignoring unplaced run instance %s (%s) not found in any container" % [uuid, def_id])
			
	return result

static func setup_from_run_state(state: BattleState) -> void:
	var permanent_to_battle_uuid_map: Dictionary = {}
	var battle_copies: Dictionary = {}
	var run_state_instances: Array[GachaBallInstance] = get_ordered_run_state_instances()

	for perm_inst in run_state_instances:
		var def = perm_inst.get_definition()
		if is_trinket_definition(def):
			continue
		var perm_loc = GameManager.run_state.get_location_for_uuid(perm_inst.ball_uuid)
		if not is_instance_valid(perm_loc):
			continue

		var battle_copy: GachaBallInstance = perm_inst.create_battle_copy()
		if not is_instance_valid(battle_copy):
			continue
		battle_copies[battle_copy.ball_uuid] = battle_copy
		permanent_to_battle_uuid_map[perm_inst.ball_uuid] = battle_copy.ball_uuid

	# Remap equipped item links between battle copies before registering into BattleState
	for battle_uuid in battle_copies.keys():
		var battle_inst: GachaBallInstance = battle_copies[battle_uuid]
		if battle_inst.get_definition().category != &"UNIT":
			continue
		var original_equipped_uuids = battle_inst.equipped_item_uuids.duplicate()
		battle_inst.equipped_item_uuids.clear()
		battle_inst.equipped_item_uuids.resize(original_equipped_uuids.size())
		battle_inst.equipped_item_uuids.fill("")
		for i in range(original_equipped_uuids.size()):
			var permanent_item_uuid: String = original_equipped_uuids[i]
			if not permanent_item_uuid.is_empty() and permanent_to_battle_uuid_map.has(permanent_item_uuid):
				var battle_item_uuid: String = permanent_to_battle_uuid_map[permanent_item_uuid]
				var item_instance: GachaBallInstance = battle_copies.get(battle_item_uuid)
				if is_instance_valid(item_instance):
					battle_inst.equipped_item_uuids[i] = battle_item_uuid
					item_instance.equipped_on_uuid = battle_inst.ball_uuid
					item_instance.equipped_slot_index = i
					item_instance.location_container_tag = C.CONTAINER_EQUIPPED_ITEM
					item_instance.location_slot_index = i

	for battle_uuid in battle_copies.keys():
		var battle_inst: GachaBallInstance = battle_copies[battle_uuid]
		var battle_def = battle_inst.get_definition()
		if is_instance_valid(battle_def) and battle_def.category == &"UNIT":
			battle_inst.current_hp = battle_inst.get_effective_starting_hp(battle_copies)
			battle_inst.current_pwr = battle_inst.get_effective_starting_pwr(battle_copies)

	# Atomically place copies into BattleState containers (or stage hero for entrance)
	for perm_inst in run_state_instances:
		var def = perm_inst.get_definition()
		if is_trinket_definition(def):
			continue
		var perm_loc = GameManager.run_state.get_location_for_uuid(perm_inst.ball_uuid)
		if not is_instance_valid(perm_loc):
			continue

		var battle_uuid: String = permanent_to_battle_uuid_map.get(perm_inst.ball_uuid, "")
		if battle_uuid.is_empty():
			continue
		var battle_copy: GachaBallInstance = battle_copies.get(battle_uuid)
		if not is_instance_valid(battle_copy):
			continue

		# Equipped items are registered atomically alongside their parent unit
		if not battle_copy.equipped_on_uuid.is_empty():
			continue

		if is_hero_definition(def):
			var hero_pos: int = perm_loc.index if perm_loc.container == RS.RUN_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP else 0
			var hero_items: Array[GachaBallInstance] = []
			for eq_uuid in battle_copy.equipped_item_uuids:
				if not eq_uuid.is_empty() and battle_copies.has(eq_uuid):
					hero_items.append(battle_copies[eq_uuid])
			state.staged_hero_placement = {
				"uuid": battle_copy.ball_uuid,
				"position": hero_pos
			}
			state.staged_hero_instance = battle_copy
			state.staged_hero_items = hero_items
			continue

		var target_container_name: StringName
		var target_index: int = -1
		var perm_container_str := String(perm_loc.container)
		if perm_container_str.begins_with("RunInventoryT"):
			assert(is_instance_valid(def), "BattleSetup: instance %s definition missing" % perm_inst.ball_uuid)
			target_container_name = &"BattleInventoryT%d" % int(def.get("tier"))
			target_index = -1
		else:
			match perm_loc.container:
				RS.RUN_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP:
					target_container_name = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP
					target_index = perm_loc.index
				RS.RUN_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF:
					target_container_name = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF
					target_index = perm_loc.index
				_:
					assert(false, "BattleSetup: unhandled container %s for %s" % [perm_loc.container, perm_inst.ball_uuid])
					continue

		var added: bool = state.bm_add_instance(battle_copy, target_container_name, target_index, true)
		assert(added, "BattleSetup: failed to place %s into %s:%d" % [battle_copy.ball_uuid, String(target_container_name), target_index])
		for eq_uuid in battle_copy.equipped_item_uuids:
			if not eq_uuid.is_empty() and battle_copies.has(eq_uuid):
				state.register_instance(battle_copies[eq_uuid])

static func stage_enemy_lineup(state: RefCounted, encounter_def: Resource) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(encounter_def):
		return
	
	var placements = encounter_def.get("enemy_placements")
	if not placements is Array:
		return
		
	state.staged_enemy_placements.clear()
	for placement in placements:
		var unit_id = placement.get("id", placement.get("unit_id", ""))
		var unit_def = Database.get_definition(unit_id)
		if not is_instance_valid(unit_def):
			continue
			
		var pos: int = int(placement.get("position", 0))
		var equipment = placement.get("equipment", placement.get("items", []))
		state.staged_enemy_placements.append({
			"id": unit_id,
			"position": pos,
			"level": int(placement.get("level", 1)),
			"bonus_hp": int(placement.get("bonus_hp", 0)),
			"bonus_pwr": int(placement.get("bonus_pwr", 0)),
			"equipment": equipment
		})

static func setup_enemy_lineup(state: BattleState, encounter_def: Resource) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(encounter_def):
		return

	var placements = encounter_def.get("enemy_placements")
	if not placements is Array:
		return

	for placement in placements:
		var unit_id = placement.get("id", placement.get("unit_id", ""))
		var unit_def = Database.get_definition(unit_id)
		if not is_instance_valid(unit_def):
			continue

		var enemy_inst := GachaBallInstance.new()
		enemy_inst.initialize(unit_def)

		var unit_level: int = int(placement.get("level", 1))
		if unit_level > 1:
			enemy_inst.set_unit_level(unit_level)
		var b_hp: int = int(placement.get("bonus_hp", 0))
		var b_pwr: int = int(placement.get("bonus_pwr", 0))
		if b_hp != 0 or b_pwr != 0:
			enemy_inst.apply_encounter_stat_bonus(b_hp, b_pwr)

		var pos: int = int(placement.get("position", 0))
		var added: bool = state.bm_add_instance(enemy_inst, C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP, pos)
		assert(added, "BattleSetup: failed to place enemy %s at EnemyLineup:%d" % [enemy_inst.ball_uuid, pos])

		var equipment = placement.get("equipment", placement.get("items", []))
		for item_data in equipment:
			var item_id = item_data if item_data is StringName or item_data is String else item_data.get("id", "")
			var item_def = Database.get_definition(item_id)
			if not is_instance_valid(item_def):
				continue

			var item_inst = GachaBallInstance.new()
			item_inst.initialize(item_def)
			var eq_res := InventoryOperations.register_and_equip_item(state, item_inst, enemy_inst.ball_uuid)
			if not eq_res.success:
				push_warning("BattleSetup: failed to equip static item %s on %s" % [item_id, enemy_inst.ball_uuid])

static func setup_enemy_trinkets(state: BattleState, encounter_def: Resource) -> void:
	var encounter: EncounterDefinition = encounter_def as EncounterDefinition
	assert(encounter != null, "BattleSetup requires an EncounterDefinition")
	var et_container: DataContainer = state.get_container(C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_TRINKETS)
	var banner_id: StringName = encounter.banner_trinket_id
	var trinket_definitions: Array[TrinketDefinition] = []
	for trinket_id: StringName in encounter.enemy_trinket_ids:
		var trinket_def: TrinketDefinition = Database.get_definition(trinket_id) as TrinketDefinition
		assert(trinket_def != null and not trinket_def.is_player_exclusive, "Invalid enemy trinket: %s" % trinket_id)
		# Normalize legacy saved encounters at the setup boundary.
		if trinket_def.is_banner:
			assert(banner_id.is_empty() or banner_id == trinket_id, "Encounter contains conflicting banners")
			banner_id = trinket_id

		trinket_definitions.append(trinket_def)
	# Register the commander first to preserve the existing ability ordering.
	if not banner_id.is_empty():
		var banner_def: TrinketDefinition = Database.get_definition(banner_id) as TrinketDefinition
		assert(banner_def != null and banner_def.is_banner and banner_def.is_enemy_exclusive, "Invalid encounter banner: %s" % banner_id)
		var banner: GachaBallInstance = GachaBallInstance.new()

		assert(added, "BattleSetup: failed to place encounter banner %s" % banner_id)
	assert(trinket_definitions.size() <= et_container.get_size(), "Encounter exceeds enemy trinket capacity")
	for slot_index: int in range(trinket_definitions.size()):
		var trinket_inst: GachaBallInstance = GachaBallInstance.new()
		trinket_inst.initialize_from_trinket(trinket_definitions[slot_index])
		var added: bool = state.bm_add_instance(trinket_inst, C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_TRINKETS, slot_index)
		assert(added, "BattleSetup: failed to place enemy trinket %s at slot %d" % [trinket_inst.ball_uuid, slot_index])
		state.enemy_trinkets.append(trinket_inst)


static func setup_player_trinkets(state: BattleState) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(GameManager.run_state):
		return
	var pt_container = state.get_container(C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_TRINKETS)
	var slot_index := 0
	for perm_inst in GameManager.run_state.get_all_instances().values():
		var def = perm_inst.get_definition()
		if not is_trinket_definition(def):
			continue
		var perm_loc = GameManager.run_state.get_location_for_uuid(perm_inst.ball_uuid)
		if not is_instance_valid(perm_loc):

			continue
		var battle_trinket: GachaBallInstance = perm_inst.create_battle_copy()
		if not is_instance_valid(battle_trinket):
			continue
		if slot_index >= pt_container.get_size():
			break
		var added: bool = state.bm_add_instance(battle_trinket, C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_TRINKETS, slot_index)
		assert(added, "BattleSetup: failed to place player trinket %s at slot %d" % [battle_trinket.ball_uuid, slot_index])
		slot_index += 1
```

```gdscript
# res://scripts/battle/BattleState.gd
class_name BattleState
extends RefCounted

## BattleState encapsulates all battle-scoped data and provides atomic mutation APIs.
## This class is responsible for:
##   - Storing battle instances (_battle_instances)
##   - Managing containers (_containers)
##   - Tracking death registry (_dead_this_turn) and turn metadata (_turn_metadata)
##   - Providing atomic mutation operations (add, remove, move, swap, equip)
##
## BattleManager creates and holds an instance of this class, delegating data operations.
## Note: FixedArrayContainer and GrowableGridContainer are global classes, no preload needed.

# Container tag constants - imported from BattleManager (single source of truth)
const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")
const BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS

# ============================================================================
# STATE DATA
# ============================================================================

## All battle instances (units, items, trinkets) in the current battle
var _battle_instances: Dictionary = {}

## Container name -> DataContainer mapping
var _containers: Dictionary = {}

## Enemy trinkets array for quick access
var enemy_trinkets: Array[GachaBallInstance] = []

## Turn-scoped metadata for first-killed tracking and resurrection flags
var _turn_metadata: Dictionary = {}

## Turn-scoped death registry: {uuid: {team, died_in_phase, def_id}}
var _dead_this_turn: Dictionary = {}

## Player Shelf capacity purchased for this battle. Resets when the next BattleState is created.
var player_shelf_slots_unlocked: int = C.INITIAL_SHELF_SLOTS

## Monotonic counter and per-UUID sequence index tracking the exact chronological order
## in which units transition to <= 0 HP during a turn.
var _lethal_sequence_counter: int = 0
var _lethal_sequence_by_uuid: Dictionary = {}

## Re-entrancy guard ensuring a single casualty's knockout cascade resolves atomically
## before outer knockout loops pick the next casualty.
var is_resolving_knockouts: bool = false

## Units whose knockout completion is deferred until pending counter-attacks resolve
var deferred_knockouts: Array[String] = []

## Deferred WHEN_ALLY_KNOCKED_OUT contexts waiting for counter-attacking units
var deferred_ally_knockouts_player: Array[TriggerContext] = []
var deferred_ally_knockouts_enemy: Array[TriggerContext] = []

## Enemy instance UUIDs deferred from final erasure until combat event playback finishes
var deferred_enemy_erasures: Array[String] = []

## Gacha tokens available for spending (synchronized with RunState if present)
var _gacha_tokens: int = 0:
	get:
		if is_instance_valid(GameManager.run_state):
			return GameManager.run_state.current_room_tokens
		return _gacha_tokens
	set(value):
		if is_instance_valid(GameManager.run_state):
			GameManager.run_state.current_room_tokens = value
		_gacha_tokens = value

## Slot effects for player lineup slots (size 5, entries can be &"burn", &"lightning", etc., or empty &"")
var player_slot_effects: Array[StringName] = [&"", &"", &"", &"", &""]

## Slot effects for enemy lineup slots (size 5, entries can be &"burn", &"lightning", etc., or empty &"")
var enemy_slot_effects: Array[StringName] = [&"", &"", &"", &"", &""]

## Staged enemy placements for sequential entrance
var staged_enemy_placements: Array = []

## Staged hero placement for entrance
var staged_hero_placement: Dictionary = {}
var staged_hero_instance: GachaBallInstance = null
var staged_hero_items: Array[GachaBallInstance] = []


# ============================================================================
# CONTAINER ACCESS
# ============================================================================

func get_container(container_name: StringName) -> DataContainer:
	if container_name.is_empty() or container_name == C.CONTAINER_EQUIPPED_ITEM:
		return null
	if _containers.has(container_name):
		return _containers[container_name]

	var new_container: DataContainer = null

	match container_name:
		BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP, BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP:
			new_container = FixedArrayContainer.new(C.LINEUP_CAP)
		BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF, BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_SHELF:
			new_container = FixedArrayContainer.new(C.SHELF_CAP)
		BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.BATTLE_DISCARD_PILE, BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_GRAVEYARD:
			new_container = GrowableGridContainer.new(24)
		BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_TRINKETS:
			new_container = FixedArrayContainer.new(C.ENEMY_TRINKET_CAP)
		BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_BANNER:
			new_container = FixedArrayContainer.new(1)
		BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_TRINKETS:
			new_container = FixedArrayContainer.new(C.PLAYER_TRINKET_CAP)
		_:
			if String(container_name).begins_with("BattleInventoryT"):
				new_container = GrowableGridContainer.new(24)
			else:
				return null

	new_container.container_tag = container_name
	_containers[container_name] = new_container
	return new_container

func find_first_empty_player_shelf_slot() -> int:
	var shelf: DataContainer = get_container(BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF)
	assert(is_instance_valid(shelf), "find_first_empty_player_shelf_slot: PlayerShelf container is required")
	var slot_limit: int = mini(player_shelf_slots_unlocked, shelf.get_size())
	for slot_index in range(slot_limit):
		if shelf.get_uuid(slot_index).is_empty():
			return slot_index
	return -1

func is_player_shelf_slot_unlocked(slot_index: int) -> bool:
	return slot_index >= 0 and slot_index < player_shelf_slots_unlocked

## Equipped item slots inherit the placement of their holder.
func is_lineup_location(location: LocationIdentifier) -> bool:
	if location.container == C.CONTAINER_EQUIPPED_ITEM:
		var holder: GachaBallInstance = get_instance(location.unit_uuid)
		assert(holder != null, "is_lineup_location: equipped slot holder is missing")
		return holder.location_container_tag in [BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP, BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP]
	return location.container in [BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP, BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP]

func get_instance(uuid: String) -> GachaBallInstance:
	return _battle_instances.get(uuid)

func get_all_instances() -> Dictionary:
	return _battle_instances

func get_instances_in_container(container_tag: StringName) -> Array[GachaBallInstance]:
	var result: Array[GachaBallInstance] = []
	var container = get_container(container_tag)
	if not is_instance_valid(container): return result
	var uuids = container.get_all_non_empty_uuids()
	for uuid in uuids:
		var instance = get_instance(uuid)
		if is_instance_valid(instance): result.append(instance)
	
	# Sort by location index
	result.sort_custom(func(a, b):
		var loc_a = get_location_for_uuid(a.ball_uuid)
		var loc_b = get_location_for_uuid(b.ball_uuid)
		if not loc_a or not loc_b: return false
		return loc_a.index < loc_b.index
	)
	return result

func get_inventory_tier_instances(tier: int) -> Array[GachaBallInstance]:
	var instances: Array[GachaBallInstance] = []
	var container_name = &"BattleInventoryT%d" % tier
	var container = get_container(container_name)
	if is_instance_valid(container):
		var uuids = container.get_all_non_empty_uuids()
		for uuid in uuids:
			var instance = get_instance(uuid)
			if is_instance_valid(instance):
				instances.append(instance)
	return instances

func get_location_for_uuid(uuid: String) -> LocationIdentifier:
	var instance = get_instance(uuid)
	if is_instance_valid(instance):
		return instance.get_location()
	return null

func get_instance_by_location(loc: LocationIdentifier) -> GachaBallInstance:
	if not is_instance_valid(loc):
		return null
	if loc.container == C.CONTAINER_EQUIPPED_ITEM:
		var parent := get_instance(loc.unit_uuid)
		if is_instance_valid(parent) and loc.index >= 0 and loc.index < parent.equipped_item_uuids.size():
			var eq_uuid := parent.equipped_item_uuids[loc.index]
			return get_instance(eq_uuid) if not eq_uuid.is_empty() else null
		return null
	var container = get_container(loc.container)
	if not is_instance_valid(container):
		return null
	var uuid = container.get_uuid(loc.index)
	return get_instance(uuid) if not uuid.is_empty() else null

# ============================================================================
# LOCATION MANAGEMENT
# ============================================================================

func update_instance_location(uuid: String, container_name: StringName, index: int) -> void:
	assert(not container_name.is_empty(), "update_instance_location: container_name cannot be empty for active instance %s" % uuid)
	var instance = get_instance(uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(instance):
		return

	instance.location_container_tag = container_name
	instance.location_slot_index = index
	if container_name != C.CONTAINER_EQUIPPED_ITEM:
		instance.equipped_on_uuid = ""
		instance.equipped_slot_index = -1

## Atomically transfer a registered instance from its current location (container or equipped slot)
## into a destination container slot. Validates destination BEFORE mutating source.
## Returns the destination slot index on success, or -1 if destination has no valid slot.
func transfer_instance_to_container(instance: GachaBallInstance, dest_container_name: StringName, dest_index: int = -1, unequip_bonus: bool = true) -> int:
	assert(is_instance_valid(instance), "transfer_instance_to_container: instance is null")
	assert(_battle_instances.has(instance.ball_uuid), "transfer_instance_to_container: instance %s is not registered in BattleState" % instance.ball_uuid)
	assert(not dest_container_name.is_empty() and dest_container_name != C.CONTAINER_EQUIPPED_ITEM, "transfer_instance_to_container: invalid destination container '%s'" % String(dest_container_name))

	var dest_container := get_container(dest_container_name)
	assert(is_instance_valid(dest_container), "transfer_instance_to_container: unknown destination container '%s'" % String(dest_container_name))

	var loc := instance.get_location()
	assert(is_instance_valid(loc), "transfer_instance_to_container: instance %s has invalid location" % instance.ball_uuid)
	# Only sealed storage can feed the Shelf. Deployment is one way until recycling.
	if dest_container_name == BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF:
		if loc.container != BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF and not String(loc.container).begins_with("BattleInventoryT"):
			return -1

	# No-op if already at exact destination container and slot
	if loc.container == dest_container_name and dest_index >= 0 and loc.index == dest_index:
		return dest_index

	# Validate destination slot BEFORE mutating source
	var slot := dest_index
	if slot < 0:
		slot = find_first_empty_player_shelf_slot() if dest_container_name == BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF else dest_container.find_first_empty_slot()
		if slot == -1:
			return -1
	else:
		if slot >= dest_container.get_size():
			return -1
		if dest_container_name == BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF and slot >= player_shelf_slots_unlocked:
			return -1
		var existing := dest_container.get_uuid(slot)
		if not existing.is_empty():
			return -1

	# Clear source location
	if loc.container == C.CONTAINER_EQUIPPED_ITEM:
		var parent := get_instance(loc.unit_uuid)
		assert(is_instance_valid(parent), "transfer_instance_to_container: missing parent unit %s for item %s" % [loc.unit_uuid, instance.ball_uuid])
		if loc.index >= 0 and loc.index < parent.equipped_item_uuids.size():
			if parent.equipped_item_uuids[loc.index] == instance.ball_uuid:
				if unequip_bonus:
					parent.unequip_item_bonus(instance)
				parent.equipped_item_uuids[loc.index] = ""
	else:
		var src_container := get_container(loc.container)
		assert(is_instance_valid(src_container), "transfer_instance_to_container: missing source container '%s' for %s" % [String(loc.container), instance.ball_uuid])
		assert(src_container.get_uuid(loc.index) == instance.ball_uuid, "transfer_instance_to_container: source slot %s:%d mismatch for %s" % [String(loc.container), loc.index, instance.ball_uuid])
		src_container.set_uuid(loc.index, "")

	# Place into destination container and update location atomically
	dest_container.set_uuid(slot, instance.ball_uuid)
	update_instance_location(instance.ball_uuid, dest_container_name, slot)
	return slot

## Atomically place the staged hero (and register any equipped hero items) into PlayerLineup.
func place_staged_hero() -> GachaBallInstance:
	if staged_hero_placement.is_empty() or not is_instance_valid(staged_hero_instance):
		return null
	var hero_inst := staged_hero_instance
	var hero_items := staged_hero_items.duplicate()
	var pos: int = int(staged_hero_placement.get("position", 0))
	staged_hero_placement.clear()
	staged_hero_instance = null
	staged_hero_items.clear()

	var added := bm_add_instance(hero_inst, BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP, pos)
	assert(added, "place_staged_hero: failed to place hero %s at PlayerLineup:%d" % [hero_inst.ball_uuid, pos])
	for item_inst in hero_items:
		if is_instance_valid(item_inst):
			_battle_instances[item_inst.ball_uuid] = item_inst
	return hero_inst

## Atomically replace a unit in its container slot with a new unit, transferring equipped items directly.
func replace_unit_preserving_items(old_unit: GachaBallInstance, new_unit: GachaBallInstance) -> bool:
	assert(is_instance_valid(old_unit) and is_instance_valid(new_unit), "replace_unit_preserving_items: invalid unit")
	var loc := old_unit.get_location()
	assert(is_instance_valid(loc) and not loc.container.is_empty() and loc.container != C.CONTAINER_EQUIPPED_ITEM, "replace_unit_preserving_items: invalid source location")
	var container := get_container(loc.container)
	assert(is_instance_valid(container) and container.get_uuid(loc.index) == old_unit.ball_uuid, "replace_unit_preserving_items: source slot mismatch")

	container.set_uuid(loc.index, new_unit.ball_uuid)
	_battle_instances[new_unit.ball_uuid] = new_unit
	update_instance_location(new_unit.ball_uuid, loc.container, loc.index)

	for slot_idx in range(old_unit.equipped_item_uuids.size()):
		var item_uuid := old_unit.equipped_item_uuids[slot_idx]
		if item_uuid.is_empty():
			continue
		var item_inst := get_instance(item_uuid)
		old_unit.equipped_item_uuids[slot_idx] = ""
		if not is_instance_valid(item_inst):
			continue
		old_unit.unequip_item_bonus(item_inst)
		if slot_idx < new_unit.equipped_item_uuids.size() and new_unit.equipped_item_uuids[slot_idx].is_empty():
			new_unit.equipped_item_uuids[slot_idx] = item_inst.ball_uuid
			item_inst.equipped_on_uuid = new_unit.ball_uuid
			item_inst.equipped_slot_index = slot_idx
			item_inst.location_container_tag = C.CONTAINER_EQUIPPED_ITEM
			item_inst.location_slot_index = slot_idx
			new_unit.equip_item_bonus(item_inst)
		else:
			var fallback_tag := BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.BATTLE_DISCARD_PILE if is_player_owned(new_unit) else BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_GRAVEYARD
			var fallback_container := get_container(fallback_tag)
			var f_slot := fallback_container.find_first_empty_slot()
			assert(f_slot != -1, "replace_unit_preserving_items: failed to allocate overflow slot")
			fallback_container.set_uuid(f_slot, item_inst.ball_uuid)
			update_instance_location(item_inst.ball_uuid, fallback_tag, f_slot)

	_battle_instances.erase(old_unit.ball_uuid)
	return true

# ============================================================================
# TURN/DEATH TRACKING
# ============================================================================

func clear_turn_data() -> void:
	_turn_metadata.clear()
	_dead_this_turn.clear()
	_lethal_sequence_counter = 0
	_lethal_sequence_by_uuid.clear()
	is_resolving_knockouts = false
	deferred_knockouts.clear()
	deferred_ally_knockouts_player.clear()
	deferred_ally_knockouts_enemy.clear()
	deferred_enemy_erasures.clear()

func record_lethal_transition(uuid: String) -> int:
	if uuid.is_empty():
		return 999999
	if not _lethal_sequence_by_uuid.has(uuid):
		_lethal_sequence_counter += 1
		_lethal_sequence_by_uuid[uuid] = _lethal_sequence_counter
	return int(_lethal_sequence_by_uuid[uuid])

func clear_lethal_transition(uuid: String) -> void:
	_lethal_sequence_by_uuid.erase(uuid)

func get_lethal_sequence(uuid: String) -> int:
	return int(_lethal_sequence_by_uuid.get(uuid, 999999))

func get_turn_metadata() -> Dictionary:
	return _turn_metadata

func get_dead_this_turn() -> Dictionary:
	return _dead_this_turn

func set_gacha_tokens(value: int) -> void:
	_gacha_tokens = value

func get_gacha_tokens() -> int:
	return _gacha_tokens

func add_gacha_tokens(amount: int) -> void:
	if amount <= 0: return
	if is_instance_valid(GameManager.run_state):
		GameManager.run_state.add_tokens(amount, true)
		_gacha_tokens = GameManager.run_state.current_room_tokens
	else:
		_gacha_tokens += amount

func spend_gacha_tokens(amount: int) -> bool:
	if is_instance_valid(GameManager.run_state):
		var success: bool = GameManager.run_state.spend_tokens(amount, true)
		if success:
			_gacha_tokens = GameManager.run_state.current_room_tokens
		return success
	if _gacha_tokens < amount:
		return false
	_gacha_tokens -= amount
	return true

# ============================================================================
# RESHUFFLE (Internal Helper)
# ============================================================================

## Helper to determine if an instance is player-owned based on container
func is_player_owned(instance: GachaBallInstance) -> bool:
	if not is_instance_valid(instance):
		return false
	var loc = instance.get_location()
	if not is_instance_valid(loc):
		return false
	if loc.container == C.CONTAINER_EQUIPPED_ITEM:
		var parent := get_instance(loc.unit_uuid)
		if is_instance_valid(parent):
			return is_player_owned(parent)
		return false
	var container = String(loc.container)
	# Player containers or common battle containers (discard, etc.)
	return (container.begins_with("Player") or
			container.begins_with("BattleInventory") or
			container == "DiscardPile")

## Reshuffle instances of specified tier from discard back to draw pool
func reshuffle_tier_from_discard(tier_to_reshuffle: int) -> bool:
	var source_container = get_container(BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.BATTLE_DISCARD_PILE)
	var dest_container_tag: StringName = &"BattleInventoryT%d" % tier_to_reshuffle
	var dest_container = get_container(dest_container_tag)
	if not is_instance_valid(source_container) or not is_instance_valid(dest_container):
		return false
	var all_discarded = get_instances_in_container(BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.BATTLE_DISCARD_PILE)
	var instances_to_move: Array[GachaBallInstance] = []
	for inst in all_discarded:
		var inst_def = inst.get_definition()
		if (inst_def is GachaBallDefinition) and inst_def.tier == tier_to_reshuffle and is_player_owned(inst):
			instances_to_move.append(inst)
	if instances_to_move.is_empty():
		return false
	for instance in instances_to_move:
		# Restore stats to base values before moving back to draw pool
		instance.reset_battle_stats()
		var new_index := transfer_instance_to_container(instance, dest_container_tag, -1)
		assert(new_index != -1, "reshuffle_tier_from_discard: failed to transfer %s to %s" % [instance.ball_uuid, String(dest_container_tag)])
	return true

func clear() -> void:
	_battle_instances.clear()
	_containers.clear()
	enemy_trinkets.clear()
	_turn_metadata.clear()
	_dead_this_turn.clear()
	_lethal_sequence_counter = 0
	_lethal_sequence_by_uuid.clear()
	is_resolving_knockouts = false
	deferred_knockouts.clear()
	deferred_ally_knockouts_player.clear()
	deferred_ally_knockouts_enemy.clear()
	deferred_enemy_erasures.clear()
	_gacha_tokens = 0
	player_slot_effects = [&"", &"", &"", &"", &""]
	enemy_slot_effects = [&"", &"", &"", &"", &""]
	staged_enemy_placements.clear()
	staged_hero_placement.clear()
	staged_hero_instance = null
	staged_hero_items.clear()


func register_instance(instance: GachaBallInstance) -> void:
	_battle_instances[instance.ball_uuid] = instance

func unregister_instance(uuid: String) -> void:
	_battle_instances.erase(uuid)

# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

## Check if an instance is in a player container (for targeting)
func is_player_unit(instance: GachaBallInstance) -> bool:
	if not is_instance_valid(instance):
		return false
	var loc = instance.get_location()
	if not is_instance_valid(loc):
		return false
	return is_in_player_container_tag(loc.container)

## Check if a container tag is a player container
func is_in_player_container_tag(tag: StringName) -> bool:
	return tag == BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP or tag == BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF

# ============================================================================
# ATOMIC MUTATION API (Pure Data - No Signals)
# ============================================================================

## Add a new instance to a container. Returns true on success.
## NOTE: Does NOT emit signals - caller is responsible for that.
func bm_add_instance(instance: GachaBallInstance, container_name: StringName, index: int = -1, allow_locked_shelf_slot: bool = false) -> bool:
	assert(is_instance_valid(instance), "bm_add_instance: instance is null")
	assert(not container_name.is_empty() and container_name != C.CONTAINER_EQUIPPED_ITEM, "bm_add_instance: invalid container_name '%s' for %s" % [String(container_name), instance.ball_uuid])
	var container = get_container(container_name)
	assert(is_instance_valid(container), "bm_add_instance: unknown battle container '%s'" % String(container_name))
	var slot := index
	if slot < 0:
		slot = find_first_empty_player_shelf_slot() if container_name == BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF else container.find_first_empty_slot()
		if slot == -1:
			return false
	else:
		if slot >= container.get_size():
			push_error("bm_add_instance rejected: slot %d out of bounds in %s (capacity=%d)" % [slot, container_name, container.get_size()])
			return false
		if container_name == BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF and slot >= player_shelf_slots_unlocked and not allow_locked_shelf_slot:
			return false
		var existing := container.get_uuid(slot)
		if not existing.is_empty():
			push_error("bm_add_instance rejected: slot %d in %s is already occupied by %s" % [slot, container_name, existing])
			return false
	container.set_uuid(slot, instance.ball_uuid)
	_battle_instances[instance.ball_uuid] = instance
	update_instance_location(instance.ball_uuid, container_name, slot)
	return true

## Remove an instance from the battle. Returns result dict with success and unit_changed_uuid.
## NOTE: Does NOT emit signals - caller is responsible for emitting signals from the result.
func bm_remove_instance(uuid: String) -> Dictionary:
	var result := {"success": false, "unit_changed_uuid": ""}

	assert(not uuid.is_empty(), "bm_remove_instance: uuid is empty")
	var instance := get_instance(uuid)
	assert(is_instance_valid(instance), "bm_remove_instance: instance not found for uuid " + uuid)
	var loc := instance.get_location()
	assert(is_instance_valid(loc), "bm_remove_instance: instance %s has invalid location" % uuid)

	if loc.container == C.CONTAINER_EQUIPPED_ITEM:
		var parent := get_instance(loc.unit_uuid)
		if not is_instance_valid(parent):
			return result
		if loc.index < 0 or loc.index >= parent.equipped_item_uuids.size():
			return result
		parent.unequip_item_bonus(instance)
		parent.equipped_item_uuids[loc.index] = ""
		result.unit_changed_uuid = parent.ball_uuid
	else:
		if instance.equipped_item_uuids.size() > 0:
			if is_player_owned(instance):
				for i in range(instance.equipped_item_uuids.size()):
					var it_uuid := instance.equipped_item_uuids[i]
					if it_uuid.is_empty():
						continue
					var it := get_instance(it_uuid)
					if not is_instance_valid(it):
						instance.equipped_item_uuids[i] = ""
						continue
					# Opened equipment cannot return to sealed Shelf storage when its holder leaves.
					var moved_slot := transfer_instance_to_container(it, BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.BATTLE_DISCARD_PILE, -1, true)
					assert(moved_slot != -1, "bm_remove_instance: failed to rehome item %s from %s" % [it.ball_uuid, instance.ball_uuid])
					result.unit_changed_uuid = instance.ball_uuid
			else:
				for i in range(instance.equipped_item_uuids.size()):
					var it_uuid := instance.equipped_item_uuids[i]
					if it_uuid.is_empty():
						continue
					instance.equipped_item_uuids[i] = ""
					_battle_instances.erase(it_uuid)

		var c := get_container(loc.container)
		assert(is_instance_valid(c), "bm_remove_instance: missing container '%s' for %s" % [String(loc.container), uuid])
		if loc.index >= 0 and c.get_uuid(loc.index) == instance.ball_uuid:
			c.set_uuid(loc.index, "")

	_battle_instances.erase(uuid)
	result.success = true
	return result

# ============================================================================
# VALIDATION
# ============================================================================

## Validate state consistency (Golden Rule check).
## Every instance in _battle_instances must be either in a valid container slot or equipped on a registered parent unit.
func validate_state_consistency() -> bool:
	# Pass 1: scan containers, detect duplicates and equipped-item leaks
	var occurrences: Dictionary = {}
	for cname in _containers.keys():
		var c: DataContainer = _containers[cname]
		if not is_instance_valid(c):
			continue
		var uuids := c.get_all_uuids()
		for i in range(uuids.size()):
			var u := uuids[i]
			if u.is_empty():
				continue
			if occurrences.has(u):
				push_error("Duplicate UUID %s also present at %s:%d" % [u, String(cname), i])
				return false
			occurrences[u] = [{"container": cname, "index": i}]
			var inst: GachaBallInstance = _battle_instances.get(u)
			if not is_instance_valid(inst):
				push_error("Container references missing battle instance %s" % u)
				return false
			if inst.get_location().container == C.CONTAINER_EQUIPPED_ITEM:
				push_error("Equipped item %s appears in a battle container slot at %s:%d" % [u, String(cname), i])
				return false
	# Pass 2: verify every registered instance's declared location matches container/equipment truth
	for u in _battle_instances.keys():
		var inst: GachaBallInstance = _battle_instances[u]
		if not is_instance_valid(inst):
			push_error("Invalid battle instance registered for UUID %s" % u)
			return false
		var loc := inst.get_location()
		if not is_instance_valid(loc):
			push_error("Instance %s returned invalid LocationIdentifier" % u)
			return false
		if loc.container == C.CONTAINER_EQUIPPED_ITEM:
			var parent: GachaBallInstance = _battle_instances.get(loc.unit_uuid)
			if not is_instance_valid(parent):
				push_error("Equipped item %s has missing parent %s" % [u, loc.unit_uuid])
				return false
			if loc.index < 0 or loc.index >= parent.equipped_item_uuids.size():
				push_error("Equipped item %s has invalid equipped index %d on %s" % [u, loc.index, parent.ball_uuid])
				return false
			if parent.equipped_item_uuids[loc.index] != u:

		else:

				push_error("Golden Rule violation: instance %s has empty container (left in unplaced state)" % u)
				return false
			var c2 := get_container(loc.container)
			if not is_instance_valid(c2):

				return false
			var all2 := c2.get_all_uuids()
			if loc.index < 0 or loc.index >= all2.size():
				push_error("Location index out of bounds for %s: %s:%d (capacity=%d)" % [u, String(loc.container), loc.index, all2.size()])
				return false
			var actual = c2.get_uuid(loc.index)
			if actual != u:
				push_error("Location/content mismatch for %s: loc %s:%d has %s" % [u, String(loc.container), loc.index, actual])
```

```gdscript
# res://scripts/battle/CausalReactionResolver.gd
class_name CausalReactionResolver
extends RefCounted

const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

## CausalReactionResolver (CRR)
##
## Centralized, deterministic state machine for managing combat reactions,
## sub-phase resolution, priority tie-breaking, and causal event tracking.
##
## Replaces ad-hoc queue slicing and index manipulation with an explicit,
## priority-tiered reaction lifecycle:
##   1. INTERCEPTION: Priority >= 300 (Guardian, Aegis Charm)
##   2. PRIMARY_MUTATION: Primary attack, stat change, or trigger effect
##   3. REACTION_COLLECT: Gathers on_hurt, on_damage_dealt, on_stat_increased
##   4. LETHAL_COUNTER: Retaliation reactions execute WHILE unit death is deferred
##   5. KNOCKOUT: Finalizes knockouts, creates KNOCKOUT events, on_death/on_ally_death
##   6. CASCADE: Drains remaining reactions in strict 3-Layer priority order

enum Phase {
	IDLE,
	INTERCEPTION,
	PRIMARY_MUTATION,
	REACTION_COLLECT,
	LETHAL_COUNTER,
	KNOCKOUT,
	CASCADE
}

## Internal priority queue of pending reactions
var _pending_reactions: Array[EffectRequest] = []

## Current lifecycle phase
var _current_phase: Phase = Phase.IDLE

## Scoped reaction tracking:
## Allows a caller to open a scope, trigger abilities, and then drain strictly
## the reactions enqueued during that scope, without index slicing or resizing.
var _next_scope_id: int = 1
var _active_scopes: Dictionary = {} # scope_id: int -> Array[EffectRequest]

# ==============================================================================
# QUEUE MANAGEMENT & SCOPES
# ==============================================================================

## Begin a reaction scope. Returns a unique scope ID.
func begin_scope() -> int:
	var scope_id := _next_scope_id
	_next_scope_id += 1
	var initial_items := {}
	for req in _pending_reactions:
		initial_items[req] = true
	_active_scopes[scope_id] = {
		"initial_items": initial_items,
		"explicit_requests": []
	}
	return scope_id

## Enqueue a single reaction request.
func enqueue(request: EffectRequest) -> void:
	assert(request != null, "CRR: Cannot enqueue null EffectRequest")
	_pending_reactions.append(request)
	for scope_id in _active_scopes:
		_active_scopes[scope_id]["explicit_requests"].append(request)

## Enqueue multiple reaction requests.
func enqueue_many(requests: Array[EffectRequest]) -> void:
	for req in requests:
		enqueue(req)

## Drain only reactions that were enqueued within the specified scope.
## Removes them from _pending_reactions and returns them sorted by 3-Layer priority.
func drain_scope(scope_id: int) -> Array[EffectRequest]:
	assert(_active_scopes.has(scope_id), "CRR: Invalid or already drained scope_id: %d" % scope_id)
	var scope_info: Dictionary = _active_scopes[scope_id]
	_active_scopes.erase(scope_id)
	
	var initial_items: Dictionary = scope_info.get("initial_items", {})
	var explicit_requests: Array = scope_info.get("explicit_requests", [])
	
	var explicit_set := {}
	for req in explicit_requests:
		explicit_set[req] = true
	
	var remaining: Array[EffectRequest] = []
	var matched: Array[EffectRequest] = []
	for req in _pending_reactions:
		if explicit_set.has(req) or not initial_items.has(req):
			matched.append(req)
		else:
			remaining.append(req)
	_pending_reactions = remaining
	
	matched.sort_custom(compare_reactions)
	return matched

## Extract and remove only reactions within the specified scope that match predicate.
## The scope remains open in _active_scopes for subsequent draining.
func drain_scope_matching(scope_id: int, predicate: Callable) -> Array[EffectRequest]:
	assert(_active_scopes.has(scope_id), "CRR: Invalid or already drained scope_id: %d" % scope_id)
	var scope_info: Dictionary = _active_scopes[scope_id]
	var initial_items: Dictionary = scope_info.get("initial_items", {})
	var explicit_requests: Array = scope_info.get("explicit_requests", [])

	var explicit_set := {}
	for req in explicit_requests:
		explicit_set[req] = true

	var remaining: Array[EffectRequest] = []
	var matched: Array[EffectRequest] = []
	for req in _pending_reactions:
		var in_scope: bool = explicit_set.has(req) or not initial_items.has(req)
		if in_scope and predicate.call(req):
			matched.append(req)
		else:
			remaining.append(req)
	_pending_reactions = remaining

	matched.sort_custom(compare_reactions)
	return matched

## Adopt existing pending reactions matching predicate into an active scope
## so they will be drained when that scope is drained.
func adopt_into_scope(scope_id: int, predicate: Callable) -> void:
	assert(_active_scopes.has(scope_id), "CRR: Invalid scope_id for adopt_into_scope: %d" % scope_id)
	var scope_info: Dictionary = _active_scopes[scope_id]
	var initial_items: Dictionary = scope_info["initial_items"]
	var explicit_requests: Array = scope_info["explicit_requests"]
	for req in _pending_reactions:
		if predicate.call(req):
			initial_items.erase(req)
			if not explicit_requests.has(req):
				explicit_requests.append(req)

## Drain all remaining reactions in strict 3-Layer priority order.
func drain_all() -> Array[EffectRequest]:
	_current_phase = Phase.CASCADE
	var requests = _pending_reactions.duplicate()
	_pending_reactions.clear()
	requests.sort_custom(compare_reactions)
	return requests

## Check if any reactions are pending.
func is_empty() -> bool:
	return _pending_reactions.is_empty()

## Get the count of pending reactions.
func size() -> int:
	return _pending_reactions.size()

## Clear all pending reactions.
func clear() -> void:
	_pending_reactions.clear()
	_active_scopes.clear()
	_current_phase = Phase.IDLE

## Get a read-only copy of pending reactions.
func get_pending_reactions() -> Array[EffectRequest]:
	return _pending_reactions.duplicate()

## Current lifecycle phase
func get_current_phase() -> Phase:
	return _current_phase

func set_current_phase(new_phase: Phase) -> void:
	_current_phase = new_phase

# ==============================================================================
# 3-LAYER DETERMINISTIC PRIORITY HIERARCHY
# ==============================================================================

## Sort pending reactions in-place using the 3-Layer Priority Hierarchy.
func sort_pending() -> void:
	_pending_reactions.sort_custom(compare_reactions)

## Deterministic 3-Layer Priority Comparator
## Layer 1: SubPhase Execution Order (Ascending: 5 up to 300)
## Layer 2: Category Rank (UNIT -> ITEM -> TRINKET)
## Layer 3: Visual Direction (The Mirror Rule: Player 4->0, Enemy 0->4)
static func compare_reactions(a: EffectRequest, b: EffectRequest) -> bool:
	# Layer 1: SubPhase Execution Order (Ascending enum value)
	if a.sub_phase != b.sub_phase:
		return a.sub_phase < b.sub_phase

	# Layer 2: Category Tie-Breaker (UNIT -> ITEM -> TRINKET)
	var rank_a := get_category_rank(a.category)
	var rank_b := get_category_rank(b.category)
	if rank_a != rank_b:
		return rank_a < rank_b

	# Layer 3: Visual Direction / Pre-Combat & Mirror Rules
	var is_pre_combat_a: bool = a.trigger_context.get("trigger_type") == C.TRIGGER_PRE_COMBAT
	var is_pre_combat_b: bool = b.trigger_context.get("trigger_type") == C.TRIGGER_PRE_COMBAT
	if is_pre_combat_a and is_pre_combat_b:
		# Team Order: Player team first, then Enemy team
		if a.is_player != b.is_player:
			return a.is_player

		# Trinket Order: Player 0 to max, Enemy max down to 0
		if a.category == &"TRINKET" and b.category == &"TRINKET":
			if a.is_player:
				if a.slot_index != b.slot_index:
					return a.slot_index < b.slot_index
			else:
				if a.slot_index != b.slot_index:
					return a.slot_index > b.slot_index
		else:
			# Unit & Item Order: Back to front (highest slot down to slot 0) for BOTH teams
			if a.slot_index != b.slot_index:
				return a.slot_index > b.slot_index
	else:
		# Standard In-Combat Mirror Rule (Left-to-Right)
		if a.is_player != b.is_player:
			return a.is_player # Player (left side) before Enemy (right side)

		if a.is_player:
			# Player team: Left-to-Right is slot 4 down to slot 0
			if a.slot_index != b.slot_index:
				return a.slot_index > b.slot_index
		else:
			# Enemy team: Left-to-Right is slot 0 up to slot 4
			if a.slot_index != b.slot_index:
				return a.slot_index < b.slot_index

	# Intra-unit item tie-breaker (slot index 0 -> N)
	if a.sub_index != b.sub_index:
		return a.sub_index < b.sub_index

	# Absolute tie-breaker: Lexical sort by ability_id
	return String(a.ability_id) < String(b.ability_id)

## Returns integer rank for category tie-breaking (Layer 2).
static func get_category_rank(cat: StringName) -> int:
	match cat:
		&"UNIT": return 1
		&"ITEM": return 2
		&"TRINKET": return 3
		_: return 4

# ==============================================================================
# PHASE-SPECIFIC EXTRACTION (Replaces Index Slicing)
# ==============================================================================

## Extract and remove all pending reactions that match a predicate.
## The extracted reactions are sorted by priority before returning.
func drain_matching(predicate: Callable) -> Array[EffectRequest]:
	var matched: Array[EffectRequest] = []
	var remaining: Array[EffectRequest] = []
	
	for req in _pending_reactions:
		if predicate.call(req):
			matched.append(req)
		else:
			remaining.append(req)
	
	_pending_reactions = remaining
	matched.sort_custom(compare_reactions)
	return matched

## Drain all Interception reactions (Priority >= 300).
## Used by basic attacks and damage commands to populate pre_impact_events.
func drain_interceptions() -> Array[EffectRequest]:
	_current_phase = Phase.INTERCEPTION
	return drain_matching(func(req: EffectRequest) -> bool:
		return req.sub_phase <= C.SubPhase.PRE_DAMAGE_INTERCEPT
	)

## Drain all Knockout Counter reactions.
## A knockout counter is a reaction from a unit that received knockout damage (HP <= 0)
## whose ability definition has execute_before_knockout == true.
func drain_lethal_counters(bm: Node) -> Array[EffectRequest]:
	_current_phase = Phase.LETHAL_COUNTER
	return drain_matching(func(req: EffectRequest) -> bool:
		if req.source_uuid.is_empty():
			return false
		var source = bm.get_instance_by_uuid(req.source_uuid)
		if not is_instance_valid(source):
			return false
		var src_def = source.get_definition()
		if not is_instance_valid(src_def) or src_def.category != &"UNIT":
			return false
		if source.current_hp > 0:
			return false
		# Check if ability has execute_before_knockout flag
		var ability_def = bm._get_ability_definition(req.ability_id, source)
		return is_instance_valid(ability_def) and ability_def.execute_before_knockout
	)

func extract_before_knockout_reactions(bm: Node) -> Array[EffectRequest]:
	return drain_lethal_counters(bm)

## Pop the highest priority reaction from the queue.
func pop_front() -> EffectRequest:
	if _pending_reactions.is_empty():
		return null
	sort_pending()
	return _pending_reactions.pop_front()

# ==============================================================================
# CAUSAL EVENT LINEAGE
# ==============================================================================

## Stamps cause_event_id onto any events that do not already have one set.
static func stamp_cause_id(events: Array[CombatEvent], cause_id: int) -> void:
	if cause_id < 0:
		return
	for event in events:
		if is_instance_valid(event) and event.cause_event_id == -1:
			event.cause_event_id = cause_id
```

```gdscript
	payload.new_pwr = payload.targets_new_pwr[0] if not payload.targets_new_pwr.is_empty() else 0
	payload.action_type = C.ACTION_BUFF
	return payload

func merge_with(next_payload: CombatPayload, target_uuids: Array[String], next_targets: Array[String]) -> void:
	for t_idx in range(next_targets.size()):
		var t_uuid = next_targets[t_idx]
		var existing_idx = target_uuids.find(t_uuid)
		
		if existing_idx >= 0:
			# Target is already in target_uuids: update its NEW values in-place (net accumulation)
			if t_idx < next_payload.targets_new_pwr.size():
				while targets_new_pwr.size() <= existing_idx:
					targets_new_pwr.append(0)
				while targets_old_pwr.size() <= existing_idx:
					targets_old_pwr.append(0)
				if t_idx < next_payload.targets_old_pwr.size() and targets_old_pwr[existing_idx] == 0:
					targets_old_pwr[existing_idx] = next_payload.targets_old_pwr[t_idx]
				targets_new_pwr[existing_idx] = next_payload.targets_new_pwr[t_idx]

			if t_idx < next_payload.targets_new_hp.size():
				while targets_new_hp.size() <= existing_idx:
					targets_new_hp.append(0)
				while targets_old_hp.size() <= existing_idx:
					targets_old_hp.append(0)
				if t_idx < next_payload.targets_old_hp.size() and targets_old_hp[existing_idx] == 0:
					targets_old_hp[existing_idx] = next_payload.targets_old_hp[t_idx]
				targets_new_hp[existing_idx] = next_payload.targets_new_hp[t_idx]

			if t_idx < next_payload.targets_max_hp.size():
				while targets_max_hp.size() <= existing_idx:
					targets_max_hp.append(0)
				targets_max_hp[existing_idx] = next_payload.targets_max_hp[t_idx]

			if t_idx < next_payload.targets_new_val.size():
				while targets_new_val.size() <= existing_idx:
					targets_new_val.append(0)
				while targets_old_val.size() <= existing_idx:
					targets_old_val.append(0)
				if t_idx < next_payload.targets_old_val.size() and targets_old_val[existing_idx] == 0:
					targets_old_val[existing_idx] = next_payload.targets_old_val[t_idx]
				targets_new_val[existing_idx] = next_payload.targets_new_val[t_idx]
		else:
			target_uuids.append(t_uuid)
			if t_idx < next_payload.targets_old_hp.size():
				targets_old_hp.append(next_payload.targets_old_hp[t_idx])
				targets_new_hp.append(next_payload.targets_new_hp[t_idx])
			if t_idx < next_payload.targets_max_hp.size():
				targets_max_hp.append(next_payload.targets_max_hp[t_idx])
			if t_idx < next_payload.targets_old_pwr.size():
				targets_old_pwr.append(next_payload.targets_old_pwr[t_idx])
				targets_new_pwr.append(next_payload.targets_new_pwr[t_idx])
			if t_idx < next_payload.targets_old_val.size():
				targets_old_val.append(next_payload.targets_old_val[t_idx])
				targets_new_val.append(next_payload.targets_new_val[t_idx])

		var has_pwr = stat == "pwr" or next_payload.stat == "pwr" or stat == "both" or next_payload.stat == "both"
		if has_hp and has_pwr:

		hp_amount += next_payload.hp_amount
	elif next_payload.stat == "hp":
		hp_amount += next_payload.amount

	if next_payload.pwr_amount != 0:
		pwr_amount += next_payload.pwr_amount
	elif next_payload.stat == "pwr":
		pwr_amount += next_payload.amount

	if next_payload.new_hp != 0:
		new_hp = next_payload.new_hp
	if next_payload.new_pwr != 0:
		new_pwr = next_payload.new_pwr

static func status_change(p_source_uuid: String, p_amount: int, p_stat: String, p_targets_old_val: Array = [], p_targets_new_val: Array = [], p_status_color: Color = Color.WHITE) -> CombatPayload:

static func damage(p_source_uuid: String, p_amount: int, p_targets_old_hp: Array = [], p_targets_new_hp: Array = [], p_targets_old_armor: Array = [], p_targets_new_armor: Array = [], p_armor_consumed: Array = []) -> CombatPayload:

	payload.armor_consumed.assign(p_armor_consumed)
```
