```gdscript
# res://scripts/effects/EffectTraitMercenaryPreCombat.gd
@tool
class_name EffectTraitMercenaryPreCombat
extends EffectDefinition

## Pre-Combat Mercenary trait effect granted by the Mercenary Trait Crest.
## Triggered on_pre_combat.
## Thresholds (Units):
##   Gold (4 Units): Each Mercenary unit gains +1 Armor for every full 10 Gold held.
##   Prismatic (5 Units): Earn 1 Gold at pre-combat once per turn (triggers on_gold_earned).

const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

func execute(source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var is_simulation: bool = context.is_simulation
	if not is_simulation:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var trinket = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(trinket):
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var team: String = context.team
	if team.is_empty():
		var container_tag = trinket.location_container_tag
		if container_tag == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_TRINKETS:
			team = "ENEMY"
		else:
			team = "PLAYER"

	var is_player = (team == "PLAYER")
	var active_traits: Dictionary = battle_manager.get_active_traits(team)
	var mercenary_units: int = int(active_traits.get("MERCENARY", 0))
	if mercenary_units < 4:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var result := EffectResult.new()
	var ability_id: StringName = (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else &"ability_trait_mercenary_pre_combat")

	# Prismatic (5 Units): Earn 1 Gold at pre-combat (resolves first so Gold threshold checks updated wallet)
	if mercenary_units >= 5 and is_player:
		battle_manager.earn_gold(1, source_uuid)

	# Gold (4 Units): Each Mercenary unit gains +1 Armor for every full 10 Gold held
	var gold: int = 0
	if is_instance_valid(GameManager.run_state):
		gold = GameManager.run_state.gold
	var armor_per_unit: int = int(gold / 10)

	if armor_per_unit > 0:
		var container_tag = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP if is_player else C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP
		var units = battle_manager.get_instances_in_container(container_tag)
		var target_uuids: Array[String] = []
		var old_vals: Array[int] = []
		var new_vals: Array[int] = []

		for unit in units:
			if not is_instance_valid(unit) or unit.current_hp <= 0:
				continue
			if not battle_manager.has_trait(unit, "MERCENARY"):
				continue

			var old_armor: int = unit.get_status_effect_amount(&"armor")
			var new_armor: int = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(unit, "armor_stacks", armor_per_unit)
			target_uuids.append(unit.ball_uuid)
			old_vals.append(old_armor)
			new_vals.append(new_armor)

		if not target_uuids.is_empty():
			result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.LOG_MESSAGE, {
				"text": "Mercenary Gold tier grants +%d Armor to Mercenaries (%d Gold)" % [armor_per_unit, gold]
			}))
			result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.STATUS_EFFECT, {
				"source_uuid": source_uuid,
				"target_uuids": target_uuids,
				"ability_id": ability_id,
				"visual_payload": CombatPayload.status_change(source_uuid, armor_per_unit, "armor_stacks", old_vals, new_vals)
			}))

	result.state_applied = true
	return result
```

```gdscript
	var is_simulation: bool = context.is_simulation
	if not is_simulation:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var trinket = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(trinket):
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var team: String = context.team
	if team.is_empty():
		var container_tag = trinket.location_container_tag
		if container_tag == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_TRINKETS:
			team = "ENEMY"
		else:
			team = "PLAYER"

	var is_player = (team == "PLAYER")
	var active_traits: Dictionary = battle_manager.get_active_traits(team)
	var plant_units: int = int(active_traits.get("PLANT", 0))
	if plant_units < 2:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var container_tag = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP if is_player else C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP
	var units = battle_manager.get_instances_in_container(container_tag)
	if units.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var frontmost_plant = battle_manager.get_frontmost_unit_on_team(is_player, "PLANT")
	if not is_instance_valid(frontmost_plant):
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var result := EffectResult.new()
	var ability_id: StringName = (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else &"ability_trait_plant")

	# L1 (2 Units): Frontmost Plant gains 1 Spikes
	var old_spk = frontmost_plant.get_status_effect_amount(&"spikes")
	var new_spk = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(frontmost_plant, "spikes_stacks", 1)
	result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.STATUS_EFFECT, {
		"source_uuid": source_uuid,
		"target_uuids": [frontmost_plant.ball_uuid],
		"ability_id": ability_id,
		"visual_payload": CombatPayload.status_change(source_uuid, 1, "spikes_stacks", [old_spk], [new_spk])
	}))

	# L3 (4 Units): All Plants gain 1 Spikes and +1 HP
	if plant_units >= 4:
		for unit in units:
			if not is_instance_valid(unit) or unit.current_hp <= 0:
				continue
			if not battle_manager.has_trait(unit, "PLANT"):
				continue

			var u_old_spk = unit.get_status_effect_amount(&"spikes")
			var u_new_spk = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(unit, "spikes_stacks", 1)
			result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.STATUS_EFFECT, {
				"source_uuid": source_uuid,
				"target_uuids": [unit.ball_uuid],
				"ability_id": ability_id,
				"visual_payload": CombatPayload.status_change(source_uuid, 1, "spikes_stacks", [u_old_spk], [u_new_spk])
			}))

			var u_old_hp = unit.current_hp
			var u_new_hp = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(unit, "hp", 1, source_uuid, C.ACTION_BUFF)
			var u_def = unit.get_definition()
			var u_max_hp = u_def.base_hp if is_instance_valid(u_def) else 0
			result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.BUFF, {
				"source_uuid": source_uuid,

				"ability_id": ability_id,
				"action_type": C.ACTION_BUFF,
				"visual_payload": CombatPayload.hp_change(source_uuid, 1, [u_old_hp], [u_new_hp], [u_max_hp])
			}))
```

```gdscript
# res://scripts/effects/EffectTraitPlantTurnStart.gd
@tool
extends EffectDefinition

## Turn-Start Plant trait effect granted by Plant Trait Trinket.
## Triggered on_turn_start.
## Thresholds (Units):
##   L2 (3 Units): Lowest-HP Plant recovers 1 HP (ACTION_HEAL).
##   L4 (5 Units): All Plants gain 1 Spikes and recover 1 HP (ACTION_HEAL).

const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

func execute(source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var is_simulation: bool = context.is_simulation
	if not is_simulation:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var trinket = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(trinket):
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var team: String = context.team
	if team.is_empty():
		var container_tag = trinket.location_container_tag
		if container_tag == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_TRINKETS:
			team = "ENEMY"
		else:
			team = "PLAYER"

	var is_player = (team == "PLAYER")
	var active_traits: Dictionary = battle_manager.get_active_traits(team)
	var plant_units: int = int(active_traits.get("PLANT", 0))
	if plant_units < 3:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var container_tag = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP if is_player else C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP
	var units = battle_manager.get_instances_in_container(container_tag)
	var living_plants: Array[GachaBallInstance] = []
	for u in units:
		if is_instance_valid(u) and u.current_hp > 0 and battle_manager.has_trait(u, "PLANT"):
			living_plants.append(u)

	if living_plants.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var result := EffectResult.new()
	var ability_id: StringName = (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else &"ability_trait_plant_turn_start")

	# L2 (3 Units): Lowest-HP Plant recovers 1 HP (ACTION_HEAL)
	living_plants.sort_custom(func(a, b):
		if a.current_hp != b.current_hp:
			return a.current_hp < b.current_hp
		if is_player:
			return a.location_slot_index > b.location_slot_index
		else:
			return a.location_slot_index < b.location_slot_index
	)
	var lowest_plant = living_plants[0]
	var old_h = lowest_plant.current_hp
	var new_h = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(lowest_plant, "hp", 1, source_uuid, C.ACTION_HEAL)
	var lp_def = lowest_plant.get_definition()
	var max_h = lp_def.base_hp if is_instance_valid(lp_def) else 0

	result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.HEAL, {
		"source_uuid": source_uuid,
		"target_uuids": [lowest_plant.ball_uuid],
		"ability_id": ability_id,
		"action_type": C.ACTION_HEAL,
		"visual_payload": CombatPayload.heal(source_uuid, 1, [old_h], [new_h], [max_h])
	}))

	# L4 (5 Units): All Plants gain 1 Spikes and recover 1 HP (ACTION_HEAL)
	if plant_units >= 5:
		for plant in living_plants:
			var old_spk = plant.get_status_effect_amount(&"spikes")
			var new_spk = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(plant, "spikes_stacks", 1)
			result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.STATUS_EFFECT, {
				"source_uuid": source_uuid,
				"target_uuids": [plant.ball_uuid],
				"ability_id": ability_id,
				"visual_payload": CombatPayload.status_change(source_uuid, 1, "spikes_stacks", [old_spk], [new_spk])
			}))

			var p_old_h = plant.current_hp
			var p_new_h = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(plant, "hp", 1, source_uuid, C.ACTION_HEAL)
			var p_def = plant.get_definition()
			var p_max_h = p_def.base_hp if is_instance_valid(p_def) else 0
			result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.HEAL, {
				"source_uuid": source_uuid,
				"target_uuids": [plant.ball_uuid],
				"ability_id": ability_id,
				"action_type": C.ACTION_HEAL,
				"visual_payload": CombatPayload.heal(source_uuid, 1, [p_old_h], [p_new_h], [p_max_h])
			}))

	result.state_applied = true
	return result
```

```gdscript
# res://scripts/effects/EffectTraitPowerBuff.gd
@tool
extends EffectDefinition

## Start-of-Combat PWR buff granted by trait trinkets.
## Triggered on_pre_combat when the battle button is pressed.
## Grants +1 PWR for 2 units, +2 for 3 units, +3 for 4 units, +4 for 5+ units of the matching trait.

const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

func execute(source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var is_simulation: bool = context.is_simulation
	if not is_simulation:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var trinket = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(trinket):
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var trinket_def = trinket.get_definition()
	var trait_name: String = ""
	if is_instance_valid(trinket_def) and "linked_trait_id" in trinket_def and trinket_def.linked_trait_id != &"":
		trait_name = String(trinket_def.linked_trait_id).to_upper()
	if trait_name.is_empty():
		trait_name = String(self.parameters.get("trait_name", "")).to_upper()
	if trait_name.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()

	# Determine team
	var team: String = context.team
	if team.is_empty():
		var container_tag = trinket.location_container_tag
		if container_tag == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_TRINKETS:
			team = "ENEMY"
		else:
			team = "PLAYER"

	var active_traits: Dictionary = battle_manager.get_active_traits(team)
	var trait_count: int = int(active_traits.get(trait_name, 0))
	if trait_count < 2:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var buff_amount: int = clampi(trait_count - 1, 1, 4)

	var lineup_container_tag = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP if team == "PLAYER" else C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP
	var lineup_units = battle_manager.get_instances_in_container(lineup_container_tag)
	var all_instances: Dictionary = battle_manager.get_all_instances()

	var target_uuids: Array[String] = []
	var old_pwrs: Array[int] = []
	var new_pwrs: Array[int] = []

	for unit in lineup_units:
		if not is_instance_valid(unit) or unit.current_hp <= 0:
			continue
		if not _unit_matches_trait(unit, trait_name, all_instances):
			continue

		var old_p: int = unit.current_pwr
		var new_p: int = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(unit, "pwr", buff_amount, source_uuid, C.ACTION_BUFF, true)
		target_uuids.append(unit.ball_uuid)
		old_pwrs.append(old_p)
		new_pwrs.append(new_p)

	if target_uuids.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var result := EffectResult.new()
	var ability_id: StringName = (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else &"ability_trait_buff")
	var trait_def: Dictionary = C.TRAIT_DEFINITIONS.get(trait_name, {})
	var trait_display = tr(trait_def.get("display_name_key", trait_name))

	result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.LOG_MESSAGE, {
		"text": "[%s] +%d PWR granted to %d units (%s)" % [trait_display, buff_amount, target_uuids.size(), team]
	}))

	result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.BUFF, {
		"source_uuid": source_uuid,
		"target_uuids": target_uuids,
		"ability_id": ability_id,
		"action_type": C.ACTION_BUFF,
		"trigger_type": (context.trigger_type if context.trigger_type != &"" else C.TRIGGER_PRE_COMBAT),
		"ability_holder_uuid": source_uuid,
		"visual_payload": CombatPayload.pwr_buff(source_uuid, buff_amount, old_pwrs, new_pwrs)
	}))

	result.state_applied = true
	return result

func _unit_matches_trait(unit: GachaBallInstance, trait_name: String, all_instances: Dictionary) -> bool:
	var upper := trait_name.to_upper()
	for tag in unit.get_active_tags(all_instances):
		var s := String(tag).to_upper()
		if s == upper or s == "SOUL_" + upper:
			return true
	return false
```

```gdscript
# res://scripts/effects/EffectTraitSpecialistPreCombat.gd
@tool
extends EffectDefinition

## Start-of-Combat Specialist trait effect granted by Specialist Trait Trinket.
## Triggered on_pre_combat.
## Thresholds (Units):
##   L1 (2 Units): If player tokens == 0, grants 1 Token (projectile from Specialist trinket to HUD).
##   L4 (5 Units): Summons temporary combat copy of lowest tier/level unit to shelf
##                 (tie-breaker: lowest tier first, lowest level second, RNGManager.combat_rng).
##                 Overflows to Discard if Shelf is full.

const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")
const EffectHandlers = preload("res://scripts/battle/EffectHandlers.gd")

func execute(source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var is_simulation: bool = context.is_simulation
	if not is_simulation:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var trinket = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(trinket):
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var team: String = context.team
	if team.is_empty():
		var container_tag = trinket.location_container_tag
		if container_tag == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_TRINKETS:
			team = "ENEMY"
		else:
			team = "PLAYER"

	var is_player = (team == "PLAYER")
	var active_traits: Dictionary = battle_manager.get_active_traits(team)
	var specialist_units: int = int(active_traits.get("SPECIALIST", 0))
	if specialist_units < 2:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var result := EffectResult.new()
	var ability_id: StringName = (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else &"ability_trait_specialist")

	# L1 (2 Units): If player tokens == 0, grants 1 Token
	if is_player and specialist_units >= 2:
		var current_tokens = battle_manager.get_gacha_tokens()
		if current_tokens == 0:
			battle_manager.add_gacha_tokens(1)
			var target_tokens = battle_manager.get_gacha_tokens()
			var token_payload := CombatPayload.new()
			token_payload.amount = 1
			token_payload.origin_uuid = source_uuid
			token_payload.target_token_amount = target_tokens

			result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.TOKEN_GAIN, {
				"source_uuid": source_uuid,
				"target_uuids": [source_uuid],
				"ability_id": ability_id,
				"amount": 1,
				"visual_payload": token_payload
			}))

	# L4 (5 Units): Summon combat copy of lowest tier/level unit
	if specialist_units >= 5:
		var container_tag = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP if is_player else C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP
		var units = battle_manager.get_instances_in_container(container_tag)
		var eligible: Array[GachaBallInstance] = []
		for u in units:
			if is_instance_valid(u) and u.current_hp > 0:
				var def = u.get_definition()
				if is_instance_valid(def) and def.category == &"UNIT":
					eligible.append(u)

		if not eligible.is_empty():
			var non_heroes = eligible.filter(func(u):
				var def = u.get_definition()
				return is_instance_valid(def) and not def.is_hero
			)
			var pool = non_heroes if not non_heroes.is_empty() else eligible

			# Sort tie-breaker: lowest tier first, lowest level second
			var min_tier = 999
			for u in pool:
				var t = u.get_definition().tier
				if t < min_tier:
					min_tier = t

			var tier_pool = pool.filter(func(u): return u.get_definition().tier == min_tier)

			var min_level = 999
			for u in tier_pool:
				if u.level < min_level:
					min_level = u.level

			var candidate_pool = tier_pool.filter(func(u): return u.level == min_level)
			var chosen_unit: GachaBallInstance = RNGManager.combat_rng.pick_random(candidate_pool)

			if is_instance_valid(chosen_unit):
				# Find destination slot: Shelf first, Discard if Shelf is full
				var shelf_tag = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_SHELF if is_player else C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_SHELF
				var shelf = battle_manager._state.get_container(shelf_tag)
				var empty_slot = -1
				if is_instance_valid(shelf):
					empty_slot = battle_manager._state.find_first_empty_player_shelf_slot() if is_player else shelf.find_first_empty_slot()
				var dest_container: StringName
				var dest_slot: int

				if empty_slot != -1:
					dest_container = shelf_tag
					dest_slot = empty_slot
				else:
					dest_container = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.BATTLE_DISCARD_PILE
					dest_slot = -1

				var copy = chosen_unit.create_battle_copy(battle_manager.get_all_instances())
				if is_instance_valid(copy):
					copy.is_temporary = true
					copy.equipped_item_uuids.fill("")
					copy.equipped_on_uuid = ""
					copy.equipped_slot_index = -1
					copy.current_hp = copy.get_effective_starting_hp(battle_manager.get_all_instances())
					copy.current_pwr = copy.get_effective_starting_pwr(battle_manager.get_all_instances())
					var placed_ok: bool = battle_manager._state.bm_add_instance(copy, dest_container, dest_slot)
					assert(placed_ok, "EffectTraitSpecialistPreCombat: failed to place combat copy %s in %s" % [copy.ball_uuid, String(dest_container)])

					var VisualDataAdapter = preload("res://scripts/VisualDataAdapter.gd")
					var snap = VisualDataAdapter.create_visual_data(copy, battle_manager.get_all_instances())
					var loc = copy.get_location()
					var summon_payload = EffectHandlers._make_summon_payload("", copy.ball_uuid, loc, snap, source_uuid, copy.get_definition().tier)

					result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.SUMMON, {
						"source_uuid": source_uuid,
						"target_uuids": [copy.ball_uuid],
						"ability_id": ability_id,
						"visual_payload": summon_payload
					}))

	result.state_applied = true
	return result
```

```gdscript
# res://scripts/effects/EffectTraitSpecialistTurnStart.gd
@tool
extends EffectDefinition

## Turn-Start Specialist trait effect granted by Specialist Trait Trinket.
## Triggered on_turn_start.
## Thresholds (Units):
##   L4 (5 Units): Frontmost Specialist gains +1 PWR per 5 Gold currently held.

const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

func execute(source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var is_simulation: bool = context.is_simulation
	if not is_simulation:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var trinket = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(trinket):
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var team: String = context.team
	if team.is_empty():
		var container_tag = trinket.location_container_tag
		if container_tag == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_TRINKETS:
			team = "ENEMY"
		else:
			team = "PLAYER"

	var is_player = (team == "PLAYER")
	var active_traits: Dictionary = battle_manager.get_active_traits(team)
	var specialist_units: int = int(active_traits.get("SPECIALIST", 0))
	if specialist_units < 5:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var frontmost_specialist = battle_manager.get_frontmost_unit_on_team(is_player, "SPECIALIST")
	if not is_instance_valid(frontmost_specialist) or frontmost_specialist.current_hp <= 0:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var gold: int = 0
	if is_player and is_instance_valid(GameManager.run_state):
		gold = GameManager.run_state.gold

	var pwr_bonus: int = int(floor(gold / 5.0))
	if pwr_bonus <= 0:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var result := EffectResult.new()
	var ability_id: StringName = (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else &"ability_trait_specialist_turn_start")

	var old_pwr = frontmost_specialist.current_pwr
	var new_pwr = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(frontmost_specialist, "pwr", pwr_bonus, source_uuid, C.ACTION_BUFF)

	result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.BUFF, {
		"source_uuid": source_uuid,
		"target_uuids": [frontmost_specialist.ball_uuid],
		"ability_id": ability_id,
		"action_type": C.ACTION_BUFF,
		"visual_payload": CombatPayload.pwr_change(source_uuid, pwr_bonus, [old_pwr], [new_pwr])
	}))

	result.state_applied = true
	return result
```

```gdscript
# res://scripts/effects/EffectTraitSupportPreCombat.gd
@tool
extends EffectDefinition

## Start-of-Combat Support trait effect granted by Support Trait Trinket.
## Triggered on_pre_combat.
## Thresholds (Units):
##   L1 (2 Units): Support units grant +1 HP to the ally directly in front.
##   L2 (3 Units): Support units also grant +1 PWR to the ally directly behind.
##   L4 (5 Units): Grants +1 HP and +1 PWR to the Hero unit (stacks with positional buffs).

const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

func execute(source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var is_simulation: bool = context.is_simulation
	if not is_simulation:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var trinket = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(trinket):
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var team: String = context.team
	if team.is_empty():
		var container_tag = trinket.location_container_tag
		if container_tag == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_TRINKETS:
			team = "ENEMY"
		else:
			team = "PLAYER"

	var is_player = (team == "PLAYER")
	var active_traits: Dictionary = battle_manager.get_active_traits(team)
	var support_units: int = int(active_traits.get("SUPPORT", 0))
	if support_units < 2:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var container_tag = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP if is_player else C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP
	var units = battle_manager.get_instances_in_container(container_tag)
	if units.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var result := EffectResult.new()
	var ability_id: StringName = (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else &"ability_trait_support")

	# Iterate backwards (or by slot) for consistent deterministic ordering
	for unit in units:
		if not is_instance_valid(unit) or unit.current_hp <= 0:
			continue
		if not battle_manager.has_trait(unit, "SUPPORT"):
			continue

		# L1 (2 Units): +1 HP to ally directly in front
		var ally_ahead = battle_manager._get_slot_ahead(unit)
		if is_instance_valid(ally_ahead) and ally_ahead.current_hp > 0:
			var old_hp = ally_ahead.current_hp
			var new_hp = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(ally_ahead, "hp", 1, unit.ball_uuid, C.ACTION_BUFF)
			var a_def = ally_ahead.get_definition()
			var a_max_hp = a_def.base_hp if is_instance_valid(a_def) else 0
			result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.BUFF, {
				"source_uuid": unit.ball_uuid,
				"target_uuids": [ally_ahead.ball_uuid],
				"ability_id": ability_id,
				"action_type": C.ACTION_BUFF,
				"visual_payload": CombatPayload.hp_change(unit.ball_uuid, 1, [old_hp], [new_hp], [a_max_hp])
			}))

		# L2 (3 Units): +1 PWR to ally directly behind
		if support_units >= 3:
			var ally_behind = battle_manager._get_ally_behind(unit)
			if is_instance_valid(ally_behind) and ally_behind.current_hp > 0:
				var old_pwr = ally_behind.current_pwr
				var new_pwr = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(ally_behind, "pwr", 1, unit.ball_uuid, C.ACTION_BUFF)
				result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.BUFF, {
					"source_uuid": unit.ball_uuid,
					"target_uuids": [ally_behind.ball_uuid],
					"ability_id": ability_id,
					"action_type": C.ACTION_BUFF,
					"visual_payload": CombatPayload.pwr_change(unit.ball_uuid, 1, [old_pwr], [new_pwr])
				}))

	# L4 (5 Units): +1 HP and +1 PWR to Hero unit (stacks cumulatively with positional buffs)
	if support_units >= 5:
		var hero = battle_manager.get_hero_on_team(is_player)
		if is_instance_valid(hero) and hero.current_hp > 0:
			var hero_old_hp = hero.current_hp
			var hero_new_hp = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(hero, "hp", 1, source_uuid, C.ACTION_BUFF)
			var hero_old_pwr = hero.current_pwr
			var hero_new_pwr = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(hero, "pwr", 1, source_uuid, C.ACTION_BUFF)
			var h_def = hero.get_definition()
			var h_max_hp = h_def.base_hp if is_instance_valid(h_def) else 0
			result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.BUFF, {
				"source_uuid": source_uuid,
				"target_uuids": [hero.ball_uuid],
				"ability_id": ability_id,
				"action_type": C.ACTION_BUFF,
				"visual_payload": CombatPayload.both_stats_change(source_uuid, 1, 1, [hero_old_hp], [hero_new_hp], [hero_old_pwr], [hero_new_pwr], [h_max_hp])
			}))

	result.state_applied = true
	return result
```

```gdscript
			team = "PLAYER"

	var is_player = (team == "PLAYER")
	var active_traits: Dictionary = battle_manager.get_active_traits(team)
	var support_units: int = int(active_traits.get("SUPPORT", 0))
	if support_units < 4:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var container_tag = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP if is_player else C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP
	var units = battle_manager.get_instances_in_container(container_tag)
	var living_allies: Array[GachaBallInstance] = []
	var living_supports: Array[GachaBallInstance] = []

	for u in units:
		if is_instance_valid(u) and u.current_hp > 0:
			living_allies.append(u)
			if battle_manager.has_trait(u, "SUPPORT"):
				living_supports.append(u)

	if living_supports.is_empty() or living_allies.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var result := EffectResult.new()
	var ability_id: StringName = (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else &"ability_trait_support_turn_start")

	# For each living Support unit, grant +1 HP to lowest-HP ally and +1 PWR to lowest-PWR ally
	for support_unit in living_supports:
		# Lowest HP ally
		living_allies.sort_custom(func(a, b):
			if a.current_hp != b.current_hp:
				return a.current_hp < b.current_hp
			if is_player:
				return a.location_slot_index > b.location_slot_index
			else:
				return a.location_slot_index < b.location_slot_index
		)
		var lowest_hp_target = living_allies[0]
		var old_hp = lowest_hp_target.current_hp
		var new_hp = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(lowest_hp_target, "hp", 1, support_unit.ball_uuid, C.ACTION_BUFF)
		var t_def = lowest_hp_target.get_definition()
		var max_hp = t_def.base_hp if is_instance_valid(t_def) else 0

		result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.BUFF, {
			"source_uuid": support_unit.ball_uuid,
			"target_uuids": [lowest_hp_target.ball_uuid],
			"ability_id": ability_id,
			"action_type": C.ACTION_BUFF,
			"visual_payload": CombatPayload.hp_change(support_unit.ball_uuid, 1, [old_hp], [new_hp], [max_hp])
		}))

		# Lowest PWR ally
		living_allies.sort_custom(func(a, b):
			if a.current_pwr != b.current_pwr:
				return a.current_pwr < b.current_pwr
			if is_player:
				return a.location_slot_index > b.location_slot_index
			else:
				return a.location_slot_index < b.location_slot_index
		)
		var lowest_pwr_target = living_allies[0]
		var old_pwr = lowest_pwr_target.current_pwr
		var new_pwr = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(lowest_pwr_target, "pwr", 1, support_unit.ball_uuid, C.ACTION_BUFF)

		result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.BUFF, {
			"source_uuid": support_unit.ball_uuid,
			"target_uuids": [lowest_pwr_target.ball_uuid],
			"ability_id": ability_id,
			"action_type": C.ACTION_BUFF,
			"visual_payload": CombatPayload.pwr_change(support_unit.ball_uuid, 1, [old_pwr], [new_pwr])
		}))

	result.state_applied = true
	return result
```

```gdscript
func execute(source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var is_simulation: bool = context.is_simulation
	if not is_simulation:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var trinket = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(trinket):
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var team: String = context.team
	if team.is_empty():
		var container_tag = trinket.location_container_tag
		if container_tag == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_TRINKETS:
			team = "ENEMY"
		else:
			team = "PLAYER"

	var is_player = (team == "PLAYER")
	var active_traits: Dictionary = battle_manager.get_active_traits(team)
	var tank_units: int = int(active_traits.get("TANK", 0))
	if tank_units < 2:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var container_tag = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP if is_player else C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP
	var units = battle_manager.get_instances_in_container(container_tag)
	if units.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var frontmost_tank = battle_manager.get_frontmost_unit_on_team(is_player, "TANK")

	var old_vals: Array[int] = []
	var new_vals: Array[int] = []

		if not is_instance_valid(unit) or unit.current_hp <= 0:
			continue
		if not battle_manager.has_trait(unit, "TANK"):
			continue

		var should_buff := false
		if tank_units >= 3:
			# L2: All Tanks gain 1 Armor
			should_buff = true
		elif tank_units >= 2:
			# L1: Frontmost Tank gains 1 Armor
			should_buff = (unit == frontmost_tank)

		if should_buff:
			var old_armor = unit.get_status_effect_amount(&"armor")
			var new_armor = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(unit, "armor_stacks", 1)
			target_uuids.append(unit.ball_uuid)
			old_vals.append(old_armor)
			new_vals.append(new_armor)

	if target_uuids.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var result := EffectResult.new()
	var ability_id: StringName = (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else &"ability_trait_tank")

	result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.STATUS_EFFECT, {
		"source_uuid": source_uuid,
		"target_uuids": target_uuids,
		"ability_id": ability_id,
		"visual_payload": CombatPayload.status_change(source_uuid, 1, "armor_stacks", old_vals, new_vals)
	}))

	result.state_applied = true
	return result
```

```gdscript
# res://scripts/effects/EffectTraitWater.gd
@tool
extends EffectDefinition

## Start-of-Combat Water trait effect granted by Water Trait Trinket.
## Triggered on_pre_combat when the battle button is pressed.
## Thresholds (Souls):
##   L1 (3 Souls): Each Water unit heals the ally directly ahead by 1 HP.
##   L2 (6 Souls): The pre-combat heal also cleanses 1 stack of negative status (Burn/Static) from that ally.
##   L4 (20 Souls): All allies cleanse 1 stack of negative status effects.

const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

func execute(source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var is_simulation: bool = context.is_simulation
	if not is_simulation:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var trinket = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(trinket):
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var team: String = context.team
	if team.is_empty():
		var container_tag = trinket.location_container_tag
		if container_tag == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_TRINKETS:
			team = "ENEMY"
		else:
			team = "PLAYER"

	var active_traits: Dictionary = battle_manager.get_active_traits(team)
	var water_souls: int = int(active_traits.get("WATER", 0))
	if water_souls < 3:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var container_tag = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP if team == "PLAYER" else C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP
	var units = battle_manager.get_instances_in_container(container_tag)
	if units.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var result := EffectResult.new()
	var ability_id: StringName = (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else &"ability_trait_water")

	# L1 & L2: Each Water unit heals ally ahead (+ cleanse at L2)
	for unit in units:
		if not is_instance_valid(unit) or unit.current_hp <= 0:
			continue
		if not battle_manager.has_trait(unit, "WATER"):
			continue

		var ally_ahead = battle_manager._get_slot_ahead(unit)
		if not is_instance_valid(ally_ahead) or ally_ahead.current_hp <= 0:
			continue

		# L1 Heal
		var old_hp = ally_ahead.current_hp
		var new_hp = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(ally_ahead, "hp", 1, unit.ball_uuid, C.ACTION_HEAL)
		var ally_def = ally_ahead.get_definition()
		var max_hp = ally_def.base_hp if is_instance_valid(ally_def) else 0

		result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.HEAL, {
			"source_uuid": unit.ball_uuid,
			"target_uuids": [ally_ahead.ball_uuid],
			"ability_id": ability_id,
			"action_type": C.ACTION_HEAL,
			"visual_payload": CombatPayload.heal(unit.ball_uuid, 1, [old_hp], [new_hp], [max_hp])
		}))

		# L2 Cleanse (Burn or Static)
		if water_souls >= 6:
			var old_burn = ally_ahead.get_status_effect_amount(&"burn")
			var old_static = ally_ahead.get_status_effect_amount(&"static")
			if old_burn > 0:
				var new_burn = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(ally_ahead, "burn_stacks", -1)
				result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.STATUS_EFFECT, {
					"source_uuid": unit.ball_uuid,
					"target_uuids": [ally_ahead.ball_uuid],
					"ability_id": ability_id,
					"visual_payload": CombatPayload.status_change(unit.ball_uuid, -1, "burn_stacks", [old_burn], [new_burn])
				}))
			elif old_static > 0:
				var new_static = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(ally_ahead, "static_stacks", -1)
				result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.STATUS_EFFECT, {
					"source_uuid": unit.ball_uuid,
					"target_uuids": [ally_ahead.ball_uuid],
					"ability_id": ability_id,
					"visual_payload": CombatPayload.status_change(unit.ball_uuid, -1, "static_stacks", [old_static], [new_static])
				}))

	# L4 Cleanse All Allies
	if water_souls >= 20:
		for ally in units:
			if not is_instance_valid(ally) or ally.current_hp <= 0:
				continue
			var old_burn = ally.get_status_effect_amount(&"burn")
			var old_static = ally.get_status_effect_amount(&"static")
			if old_burn > 0:
				var new_burn = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(ally, "burn_stacks", -1)
				result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.STATUS_EFFECT, {
					"source_uuid": source_uuid,
					"target_uuids": [ally.ball_uuid],
					"ability_id": ability_id,
					"visual_payload": CombatPayload.status_change(source_uuid, -1, "burn_stacks", [old_burn], [new_burn])
				}))
			elif old_static > 0:
				var new_static = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(ally, "static_stacks", -1)
				result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.STATUS_EFFECT, {
					"source_uuid": source_uuid,
					"target_uuids": [ally.ball_uuid],
					"ability_id": ability_id,
					"visual_payload": CombatPayload.status_change(source_uuid, -1, "static_stacks", [old_static], [new_static])
				}))

	result.state_applied = true
	return result
```

```gdscript
# res://scripts/effects/EffectTraitWaterTurnStart.gd
@tool
extends EffectDefinition

## Turn-Start Water trait effect granted by Water Trait Trinket.
## Triggered on_turn_start.
## Thresholds (Souls):
##   L3 (12 Souls): Heals ally with lowest current HP by 1 HP (tie-breaker: frontmost).
##   L5 (32 Souls): All allies consume all Burn and Static stacks, healing 1 HP per stack consumed.

const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

func execute(source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var is_simulation: bool = context.is_simulation
	if not is_simulation:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var trinket = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(trinket):
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var team: String = context.team
	if team.is_empty():
		var container_tag = trinket.location_container_tag
		if container_tag == C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_TRINKETS:
			team = "ENEMY"
		else:
			team = "PLAYER"

	var is_player = (team == "PLAYER")
	var active_traits: Dictionary = battle_manager.get_active_traits(team)
	var water_souls: int = int(active_traits.get("WATER", 0))
	if water_souls < 12:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var container_tag = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP if is_player else C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP
	var units = battle_manager.get_instances_in_container(container_tag)
	var living_allies: Array[GachaBallInstance] = []
	for u in units:
		if is_instance_valid(u) and u.current_hp > 0:
			living_allies.append(u)

	if living_allies.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var result := EffectResult.new()
	var ability_id: StringName = (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else &"ability_trait_water_turn_start")

	# L3 (12 Souls): Heal lowest-HP ally by 1 HP (tie-breaker: frontmost)
	living_allies.sort_custom(func(a, b):
		if a.current_hp != b.current_hp:
			return a.current_hp < b.current_hp
		# Tie-breaker: frontmost (higher slot for player, lower slot for enemy)
		if is_player:
			return a.location_slot_index > b.location_slot_index
		else:
			return a.location_slot_index < b.location_slot_index
	)
	var lowest_ally = living_allies[0]
	var old_hp = lowest_ally.current_hp
	var new_hp = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(lowest_ally, "hp", 1, source_uuid, C.ACTION_HEAL)
	var lowest_def = lowest_ally.get_definition()
	var max_hp = lowest_def.base_hp if is_instance_valid(lowest_def) else 0

	result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.HEAL, {
		"source_uuid": source_uuid,
		"target_uuids": [lowest_ally.ball_uuid],
		"ability_id": ability_id,
		"action_type": C.ACTION_HEAL,
		"visual_payload": CombatPayload.heal(source_uuid, 1, [old_hp], [new_hp], [max_hp])
	}))

	# L5 (32 Souls): All allies consume all Burn and Static stacks, healing 1 HP per stack consumed
	if water_souls >= 32:
		for ally in living_allies:
			var burn_st = ally.get_status_effect_amount(&"burn")
			var static_st = ally.get_status_effect_amount(&"static")
			var total_stacks = burn_st + static_st
			if total_stacks > 0:
				ally.clear_status_effect(&"burn")
				ally.clear_status_effect(&"static")
				var ally_old_hp = ally.current_hp
				var ally_new_hp = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(ally, "hp", total_stacks, source_uuid, C.ACTION_HEAL)
				var a_def = ally.get_definition()
				var a_max_hp = a_def.base_hp if is_instance_valid(a_def) else 0

				result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.STATUS_EFFECT, {
					"source_uuid": source_uuid,
					"target_uuids": [ally.ball_uuid],
					"ability_id": ability_id,
					"visual_payload": CombatPayload.status_change(source_uuid, -burn_st, "burn_stacks", [burn_st], [0])
				}))
				result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.STATUS_EFFECT, {
					"source_uuid": source_uuid,
					"target_uuids": [ally.ball_uuid],
					"ability_id": ability_id,
					"visual_payload": CombatPayload.status_change(source_uuid, -static_st, "static_stacks", [static_st], [0])
				}))
				result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.HEAL, {
					"source_uuid": source_uuid,
					"target_uuids": [ally.ball_uuid],
					"ability_id": ability_id,
					"action_type": C.ACTION_HEAL,
					"visual_payload": CombatPayload.heal(source_uuid, total_stacks, [ally_old_hp], [ally_new_hp], [a_max_hp])
				}))

	result.state_applied = true
	return result
```

```gdscript
# res://scripts/effects/EffectTrinityCharm.gd
@tool
extends EffectDefinition

## Effect for Trinity Charm: Tracks drawn tiers in a turn/encounter. 
## If all 3 tiers are drawn, grants 1 token. Resets on turn end or battle start.

func execute(_source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var trinket: GachaBallInstance = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(_source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(trinket):
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var trigger: StringName = context.trigger_type
	var is_simulation: bool = context.is_simulation

	if trigger == C.TRIGGER_ON_GACHA_DRAW:
		var tier: int = context.tier
		if tier >= 1 and tier <= 3:
			# Track the tier being drawn
			var key = StringName("trinity_t%d_drawn" % tier)
			trinket.add_status_effect(key, 1)

			var t1 = trinket.status_effects.get(&"trinity_t1_drawn", 0) > 0
			var t2 = trinket.status_effects.get(&"trinity_t2_drawn", 0) > 0
			var t3 = trinket.status_effects.get(&"trinity_t3_drawn", 0) > 0

			if t1 and t2 and t3:
				if trinket.status_effects.get(&"trinity_rewarded_this_cycle", 0) == 0:
					trinket.add_status_effect(&"trinity_rewarded_this_cycle", 1)
					
					if is_simulation:
						battle_manager._state.add_gacha_tokens(1)
						var target_tokens: int = battle_manager.get_gacha_tokens()
						var result := EffectResult.new()
						result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.LOG_MESSAGE, {
							"text": "Trinity Charm: Gained 1 token!"
						}))
						result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.TOKEN_GAIN, {
							"source_uuid": _source_uuid,
							"target_uuids": [_source_uuid],
							"ability_holder_uuid": _source_uuid,
							"ability_id": "ability_trinket_trinity_charm_draw",
							"amount": 1,
							"visual_payload": _make_token_payload(_source_uuid, target_tokens)
						}))
						result.state_applied = true
						return result
					else:
						battle_manager.add_gacha_token(1)
						var non_sim_result := EffectResult.new()
						non_sim_result.state_applied = true
						return non_sim_result

	elif trigger == C.TRIGGER_AT_TURN_END or trigger == C.TRIGGER_AT_BATTLE_START:
		# Reset all tracking
		trinket.status_effects.erase(&"trinity_t1_drawn")
		trinket.status_effects.erase(&"trinity_t2_drawn")
		trinket.status_effects.erase(&"trinity_t3_drawn")
		trinket.status_effects.erase(&"trinity_rewarded_this_cycle")

			# Return a valid result so simulation succeeds but does nothing visual
		if is_simulation:
			var result := EffectResult.new()
			result.state_applied = true
			return result
		var non_sim_result := EffectResult.new()
		non_sim_result.state_applied = true
		return non_sim_result

	return EffectResult.empty()

func _make_token_payload(source_uuid: String, target_tokens: int = -1) -> CombatPayload:
	var payload := CombatPayload.new()
	payload.amount = 1
	payload.origin_uuid = source_uuid
	payload.target_token_amount = target_tokens
	return payload
```

```gdscript
# res://scripts/effects/EffectTwinCharmScaling.gd
@tool
extends EffectDefinition

## Grants allied units +1 PWR for each pair of that unit
## in the allied battle pool (lineup, shelf, gacha trays, discard).
func execute(source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var is_simulation := true # Always true so it generates visual events for animator
	var all_instances: Dictionary = battle_manager.get_all_instances()
	var source: GachaBallInstance = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(source):
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var team: String = context.team if not context.team.is_empty() else _get_team_for_instance(source, battle_manager)
	var status_key := StringName("twin_charm_scaling_" + team)
	var copy_counts: Dictionary = {}
	var changed_units := 0
	var total_delta := 0


	for uuid in all_instances:
		var inst: GachaBallInstance = all_instances[uuid]
		if not is_instance_valid(inst):
			continue
		if not _is_valid_count_target(inst, team, battle_manager):
			continue
		copy_counts[inst.definition_id] = int(copy_counts.get(inst.definition_id, 0)) + 1

	var buff_groups: Dictionary = {} # delta -> { "targets": [], "old_pwrs": [], "new_pwrs": [] }
	var debuff_groups: Dictionary = {}
	var silent_buff_groups: Dictionary = {}
	var silent_debuff_groups: Dictionary = {} # abs(delta) -> { "targets": [], "old_pwrs": [], "new_pwrs": [] }

	for uuid in all_instances:
		var inst: GachaBallInstance = all_instances[uuid]
		if not is_instance_valid(inst) or battle_manager.is_dead_this_turn(uuid):
			continue
		if inst.location_container_tag in [&"PlayerShelf", &"EnemyShelf"]:
			continue

		var last_bonus: int = inst.get_status_effect_amount(status_key)
		if not _is_valid_count_target(inst, team, battle_manager):
			if last_bonus > 0:
				_clear_scaling(inst, status_key, last_bonus, is_simulation)
				changed_units += 1
				total_delta -= last_bonus
				
				if is_simulation and _is_on_board(inst):
					if not debuff_groups.has(last_bonus):
						debuff_groups[last_bonus] = {"targets": [] as Array[String], "old_pwrs": [] as Array[int], "new_pwrs": [] as Array[int]}
					debuff_groups[last_bonus]["targets"].append(uuid)
					debuff_groups[last_bonus]["old_pwrs"].append(inst.current_pwr + last_bonus)
					debuff_groups[last_bonus]["new_pwrs"].append(inst.current_pwr)
			continue

		var total_copies: int = int(copy_counts.get(inst.definition_id, 0))
		var bonus_pwr: int = total_copies / 2
		
		# If the unit is not on the board yet (e.g. in the Gacha Machine/Inventory), 
		# it shouldn't hold the stat buff. This ensures the delta triggers when it enters the board.
		if not _is_on_board(inst):
			bonus_pwr = 0
			
		var delta: int = bonus_pwr - last_bonus
		if delta == 0:
			continue

		_set_scaling(inst, status_key, last_bonus, bonus_pwr, delta, is_simulation)
		changed_units += 1
		total_delta += delta

		if is_simulation and _is_on_board(inst):
			var is_silent = inst.has_meta("skip_initial_scaling_anim")
			if delta > 0:
				var groups = silent_buff_groups if is_silent else buff_groups
				if not groups.has(delta):
					groups[delta] = {"targets": [] as Array[String], "old_pwrs": [] as Array[int], "new_pwrs": [] as Array[int]}
				groups[delta]["targets"].append(uuid)
				groups[delta]["old_pwrs"].append(inst.current_pwr - delta)
				groups[delta]["new_pwrs"].append(inst.current_pwr)
			else:
				var groups = silent_debuff_groups if is_silent else debuff_groups
				var abs_delta = abs(delta)
				if not groups.has(abs_delta):
					groups[abs_delta] = {"targets": [] as Array[String], "old_pwrs": [] as Array[int], "new_pwrs": [] as Array[int]}
				groups[abs_delta]["targets"].append(uuid)
				groups[abs_delta]["old_pwrs"].append(inst.current_pwr - delta)
				groups[abs_delta]["new_pwrs"].append(inst.current_pwr)

	if changed_units == 0:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	if is_simulation:
		var result := EffectResult.new()
		var visual_source_uuid = source_uuid

		for d in buff_groups:
			result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.BUFF, {
				"source_uuid": visual_source_uuid,
				"target_uuids": buff_groups[d]["targets"],
				"ability_id": (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else &"twin_charm_scaling"),
				"ability_holder_uuid": source_uuid,
				"visual_payload": CombatPayload.pwr_change(visual_source_uuid, d, buff_groups[d]["old_pwrs"], buff_groups[d]["new_pwrs"])
			}))
			
		for d in silent_buff_groups:
			var payload = CombatPayload.pwr_change("", d, silent_buff_groups[d]["old_pwrs"], silent_buff_groups[d]["new_pwrs"])
			payload.skip_bump = true
			result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.BUFF, {
				"source_uuid": "",
				"target_uuids": silent_buff_groups[d]["targets"],
				"ability_holder_uuid": source_uuid,
				"visual_payload": payload
			}))
			
		for d in debuff_groups:
			result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.BUFF, {
				"source_uuid": visual_source_uuid,
				"target_uuids": debuff_groups[d]["targets"],
				"ability_holder_uuid": source_uuid,
				"visual_payload": CombatPayload.pwr_change(visual_source_uuid, -d, debuff_groups[d]["old_pwrs"], debuff_groups[d]["new_pwrs"])
			}))
			
		for d in silent_debuff_groups:
			var payload = CombatPayload.pwr_change("", -d, silent_debuff_groups[d]["old_pwrs"], silent_debuff_groups[d]["new_pwrs"])
			payload.skip_bump = true
			result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.BUFF, {
				"source_uuid": "",
				"target_uuids": silent_debuff_groups[d]["targets"],
				"ability_holder_uuid": source_uuid,
				"visual_payload": payload
			}))
			
		result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.LOG_MESSAGE, {
			"text": "Twin Charm updated %d units (%+d total PWR)" % [changed_units, total_delta]
		}))
		result.state_applied = true
		return result

	var non_sim_result := EffectResult.new()
	non_sim_result.state_applied = true
	return non_sim_result

func _set_scaling(unit: GachaBallInstance, status_key: StringName, last_bonus: int, new_bonus: int, delta: int, is_simulation: bool) -> void:
	if last_bonus > 0:
		_clear_status(unit, status_key, last_bonus, is_simulation)
	if new_bonus > 0:
		unit.add_status_effect_silent(status_key, new_bonus)
	unit.apply_pwr_delta(delta, {
		"silent": is_simulation,
		"merge_source_type": &"CONDITIONAL_ABILITY"
	})

func _clear_scaling(unit: GachaBallInstance, status_key: StringName, last_bonus: int, is_simulation: bool) -> void:
	_clear_status(unit, status_key, last_bonus, is_simulation)
	unit.apply_pwr_delta(-last_bonus, {
		"silent": is_simulation,
		"merge_source_type": &"CONDITIONAL_ABILITY"
	})

func _clear_status(unit: GachaBallInstance, status_key: StringName, last_bonus: int, is_simulation: bool) -> void:
	if is_simulation:
		unit.status_effects.erase(status_key)
	else:
		unit.clear_status_effect(status_key)

func _is_valid_count_target(inst: GachaBallInstance, team: String, battle_manager: Node) -> bool:
	if not is_instance_valid(inst):
		return false
	var definition: Resource = inst.get_definition()
	if not is_instance_valid(definition):
		return false
	if definition.category != &"UNIT":
		return false
	return _get_team_for_instance(inst, battle_manager) == team

func _get_team_for_instance(inst: GachaBallInstance, battle_manager: Node) -> String:
	if not is_instance_valid(inst):
		return ""
	if battle_manager._is_player_owned(inst):
		return "PLAYER"

	var container: StringName = inst.location_container_tag
	if container == &"EnemyLineup" or container == &"EnemyShelf":
		return "ENEMY"

	return ""

func _is_on_board(inst: GachaBallInstance) -> bool:
	if not is_instance_valid(inst):
		return false
	var container: StringName = inst.location_container_tag
	return container == &"PlayerLineup" or container == &"EnemyLineup"
```

```gdscript
@tool
extends EffectDefinition

## At pre-combat, if the trinket's team has fewer living lineup units than the enemy,
## grant all living allied lineup units 2 Armor per unit difference.
func execute(source_uuid: String, targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var is_simulation: bool = bool(context.is_simulation)
	var team: String = String(context.team)
	if team.is_empty():
		var source_inst_fallback: GachaBallInstance = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
		if is_instance_valid(source_inst_fallback):
			team = "PLAYER" if source_inst_fallback.location_container_tag == &"PlayerTrinkets" else "ENEMY"

	var ally_lineup_tag: StringName = &"PlayerLineup" if team == "PLAYER" else &"EnemyLineup"
	var enemy_lineup_tag: StringName = &"EnemyLineup" if team == "PLAYER" else &"PlayerLineup"

	var ally_count := 0
	for unit in battle_manager.get_instances_in_container(ally_lineup_tag):
		if is_instance_valid(unit) and unit.current_hp > 0:
			ally_count += 1

	var enemy_count := 0
	for unit in battle_manager.get_instances_in_container(enemy_lineup_tag):
		if is_instance_valid(unit) and unit.current_hp > 0:
			enemy_count += 1

	var difference: int = enemy_count - ally_count
	if difference <= 0:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var amount: int = difference * 2
	if targets.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var source_name := String((context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else "effect"))
	var source_inst: GachaBallInstance = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if is_instance_valid(source_inst):
		var display_name := BattleHelpers.get_instance_display_name(source_inst)
		if not display_name.is_empty():
			source_name = display_name

	var target_names: Array[String] = []
	var targets_old_val: Array[int] = []
	var targets_new_val: Array[int] = []
	var valid_targets: Array[String] = []

	for target_uuid in targets:
		var target_inst: GachaBallInstance = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(target_uuid)
		if not is_instance_valid(target_inst) or target_inst.current_hp <= 0:
			continue

		valid_targets.append(target_uuid)
		target_names.append(BattleHelpers.get_instance_display_name(target_inst))
		targets_old_val.append(target_inst.get_status_effect_amount(&"armor"))
		targets_new_val.append(battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(target_inst, "armor_stacks", amount))

	if valid_targets.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()

	var result := EffectResult.new()
	result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.LOG_MESSAGE, {
		"text": "%s grants %s +%d Armor" % [source_name, " and ".join(target_names), amount]
	}))
	result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.STATUS_EFFECT, {
		"source_uuid": source_uuid,
		"target_uuids": valid_targets,
		"ability_id": (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else &"ability_trinket_underdog_emblem"),
		"trigger_type": context.trigger_type,
		"ability_holder_uuid": source_uuid,
		"visual_payload": CombatPayload.status_change(source_uuid, amount, "armor_stacks", targets_old_val, targets_new_val)
	}))
	result.state_applied = true
	return result
```

```gdscript
# res://scripts/EffectSetHPToGold.gd
@tool
class_name EffectSetHPToGold
extends EffectDefinition

## Sets the source unit's HP equal to the current Gold count.
## Used for the Tier 2 unit "Merchant".

const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

func execute(source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var source = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(source):
		return EffectResult.new()

	var gold = 0
	if is_instance_valid(GameManager.run_state):
		gold = GameManager.run_state.gold
	
	var current_hp = source.current_hp
	
	# Calculate delta to reach target
	var delta = gold - current_hp
	
	if delta == 0:
		return EffectResult.new()
		
	var action_type := C.ACTION_BUFF if delta > 0 else C.ACTION_DEBUFF
	
	# Apply change via BattleManager
	var hp_result = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(source, "hp", delta, source_uuid, action_type, false)
	var new_hp: int = current_hp
	if hp_result is Dictionary:
		new_hp = hp_result.get("new_hp", current_hp)
	elif hp_result != null:
		new_hp = int(hp_result)
		
	var result = EffectResult.new()
	
	var base_hp = source.get_definition().base_hp if is_instance_valid(source.get_definition()) else current_hp
	var payload: CombatPayload
	if delta > 0:
		payload = CombatPayload.hp_buff(source_uuid, delta, [current_hp], [new_hp], [base_hp])
	else:
		payload = CombatPayload.hp_debuff(source_uuid, delta, [current_hp], [new_hp])
	
	# Create visual event
	var event = CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.BUFF if delta > 0 else CombatEvent.Type.DEBUFF, {
		"source_uuid": source_uuid,
		"target_uuids": [source_uuid],
		"ability_id": (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else ""),
		"action_type": action_type,
		"visual_payload": payload
	})
	
	result.add_event(event)
	result.state_applied = true
	return result
```

```gdscript
@tool
class_name EffectSetPWRToGold
extends EffectDefinition

## Sets the source unit's PWR equal to the current Gold count.
## Used for the Tier 2 unit "Merchant".

const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

func execute(source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var source = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(source):
		return EffectResult.new()

	var trigger = context.trigger_type
	var drawn_uuid = context.drawn_uuid
	
	# The on_board_enter trigger handles filtering the target, so we don't need a guard clause here.
	var gold = 0
	if is_instance_valid(GameManager.run_state):
		var multiplier: float = self.parameters.get("multiplier", 1.0)
		gold = maxi(1, int(GameManager.run_state.gold * multiplier))
	
	# Delta-safe scaling logic: calculate the required bonus relative to base stats
	var base_pwr = source.get_definition_base_pwr()
	var required_bonus = max(0, gold - base_pwr)
	
	# Fetch previously applied bonus
	var previous_bonus = source.get_meta("gold_pwr_bonus", 0)
	var delta = required_bonus - previous_bonus
	
	if delta == 0:
		return EffectResult.new()
		
	# Store the new total bonus applied
	source.set_meta("gold_pwr_bonus", required_bonus)
	
	var action_type := C.ACTION_BUFF if delta > 0 else C.ACTION_DEBUFF
	# Apply change via BattleManager
	var pwr_result = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(source, "pwr", delta, source_uuid, action_type, false)
	var _new_pwr: int = source.current_pwr
	if pwr_result is Dictionary:
		_new_pwr = pwr_result.get("new_pwr", source.current_pwr)
	elif pwr_result != null:
		_new_pwr = int(pwr_result)
	
	var unit_name = BattleHelpers.get_instance_display_name(source)
	
	var result = EffectResult.new()
	# Only log if it's a significant change to prevent spamming logs on every board event
	if abs(delta) >= 1:
		result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.LOG_MESSAGE, {
			"text": "%s's investments mature! PWR set to %d (current Gold)" % [unit_name, gold]
		}))
	
	result.state_applied = true
	return result
```

### File: `scripts/EffectShockwave.gd`
```gdscript
# res://scripts/EffectShockwave.gd
@tool
extends EffectDefinition
const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

## An effect that deals shockwave damage to the frontmost enemy and up to 2 adjacent slots behind.
## 1. Finds the frontmost LIVING enemy (like basic attack)
## 2. Hits that enemy's slot
## 3. Hits the slot directly BEHIND it (slot_index + 1)
## 4. Hits the slot behind THAT (slot_index + 2)
## Empty slots are skipped (damage still decays). Damage halves (50% falloff) for each subsequent target.
## Parameters:
##   - damage: { pwr_multiplier: 1.0, base_value: 0 } for stat scaling
##   - cascade_falloff: float (default 0.5) - multiplier applied per slot behind
##   - cascade_depth: int (default 2) - how many slots BEHIND the frontmost to check

func execute(source_uuid: String, targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, _context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	if targets.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()

	# Zero-Instance-Query Compliant: Use centralized stat calculator
	var base_damage = StatScaling.calculate(parameters.get("damage"), _context, "EffectShockwave")
	var falloff: float = parameters.get("cascade_falloff", 0.5)
	var cascade_depth: int = parameters.get("cascade_depth", 2) # 2 slots behind frontmost
	
	# Get enemy lineup container
	# Note: We still need to query source instance for team detection (is_player_unit)
	# This is acceptable since it's about team membership, not stats
	var source_instance = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(source_instance):
		push_warning("[EffectShockwave] source instance not found for team detection")
		return EffectResult.empty()
	
	var is_player_unit = battle_manager._is_player_unit(source_instance)
	var container_tag: StringName
	if is_player_unit:
		container_tag = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.ENEMY_LINEUP
	else:
		container_tag = C.BATTLE_CONTAINER_TAGS.PLAYER_LINEUP
	
	var container = battle_manager.get_container(container_tag)
	if not is_instance_valid(container):
		return EffectResult.empty()
	
	# Step 1: Start cascade from the resolved target
	var frontmost_slot: int = -1
	var all_uuids = container.get_all_uuids()
	var target_uuid = targets[0]
	
	for slot_index in range(all_uuids.size()):
		if all_uuids[slot_index] == target_uuid:
			frontmost_slot = slot_index
			break
	
	if frontmost_slot == -1:
		return EffectResult.empty() # No living enemies
	
	# Step 2: Calculate damage for frontmost slot + cascade_depth slots behind
	# on_before_damage is triggered for each target in the loop below.
	# on_hurt is triggered by CombatSimulator after applying damage from cascade_request.
	var damage_data: Array[EffectResult.CascadeRequestItem] = []
	var current_damage = base_damage
	var damage_index: int = 0 # For skip_bump logic
	
	# Cascade direction depends on who is attacking:
	# - Player attacks: cascade from frontmost (index 0) toward back (higher indices) = +1
	# - Enemy attacks: cascade from frontmost (highest index) toward back (lower indices) = -1
	var cascade_direction: int = 1 if is_player_unit else -1
	
	for offset in range(cascade_depth + 1): # 0, 1, 2 = frontmost + 2 behind
		var target_slot = frontmost_slot + (offset * cascade_direction)
		if target_slot < 0 or target_slot >= all_uuids.size():
			break # Beyond lineup bounds
		
		if current_damage < 1:
			break
		
		var uuid = container.get_uuid(target_slot)
		if uuid.is_empty():
			# Empty slot - damage still decays, but nothing to hit
			current_damage = current_damage * falloff
			continue
		
		var target = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(uuid)
		if not is_instance_valid(target) or target.current_hp <= 0:
			# Dead unit or invalid - damage still decays
			current_damage = current_damage * falloff
			continue
		
		var damage_amount = int(current_damage)
		
		# Trigger on_before_damage for this target (defensive abilities like Defensive Stance)
		var before_attack_context := TriggerContext.new()
		before_attack_context.source_uuid = target.ball_uuid
		before_attack_context.defender_uuid = target.ball_uuid
		before_attack_context.attacker_uuid = source_uuid
		before_attack_context.target_initial_hp = target.current_hp
		before_attack_context.is_simulation = true
		AbilityResolver.process_trigger(C.TRIGGER_BEFORE_TAKING_DAMAGE, before_attack_context)
		
		# Drain the on_before_damage reactions immediately (like BasicAttackEffect does)
		battle_manager.drain_pending_reactions_inline(0)
		
		# Add to damage data - CombatSimulator will handle applying damage and triggering on_hurt
		damage_data.append(EffectResult.CascadeRequestItem.new(
			target.ball_uuid,
			damage_amount,
			(damage_index > 0) # Only bump for the first actual hit
		))
		
		damage_index += 1
		current_damage = current_damage * falloff

	if damage_data.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()

	# Return EffectResult with cascade_request for CombatSimulator to process
	var result := EffectResult.new()
	var damage_type = parameters.get("damage_type", C.DamageType.MELEE)
	result.cascade_request = EffectResult.CascadeRequest.new(
		damage_type,
		damage_data
	)
	return result
```

```gdscript
# res://scripts/EffectSummonBlessing.gd
@tool
class_name EffectSummonBlessing
extends EffectDefinition

const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

## Effect that buffs a newly summoned ally unit with HP.
## Used by the Tier 3 F unit's "Summon Blessing" ability.
##
## Parameters:
##   - hp_amount: int - Amount of HP to grant to the summoned unit (default 3)
##
## Context expected:
##   - summoned_uuid: String - UUID of the newly summoned unit

func execute(source_uuid: String, _resolved_targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var result := EffectResult.new()
	
	# Get the summoned unit from context
	var summoned_uuid: String = context.summoned_uuid
	if summoned_uuid.is_empty():
		return result
	
	# Get target instance
	var target_inst: GachaBallInstance = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(summoned_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(target_inst) or target_inst.current_hp <= 0:
		return result
	
	# Get HP amount from parameters (default 3)
	var hp_amount: int = int(parameters.get("hp_amount", 3))
	if hp_amount <= 0:
		return result
	
	# Capture old HP
	var old_hp: int = target_inst.current_hp
	var max_hp: int = 0
	var target_def = target_inst.get_definition()
	if is_instance_valid(target_def):
		max_hp = target_def.base_hp
	
	# Apply HP buff
	var new_hp = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(target_inst, "hp", hp_amount, source_uuid, C.ACTION_BUFF, true)
	
	# Get source name for log
	var source_name: String = ""
	if not source_uuid.is_empty():
		var src = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
		source_name = BattleHelpers.get_instance_display_name(src)
	if source_name == "":
		source_name = "Summon Blessing"
	
	var target_name: String = BattleHelpers.get_instance_display_name(target_inst)
	
	# Add log event
	result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.LOG_MESSAGE, {
		"text": "%s blesses %s with +%d HP" % [source_name, target_name, hp_amount]
	}))
	
	# Add BUFF event for animation (BuffAnimation now handles both HP and PWR)
	result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.BUFF, {
		"source_uuid": source_uuid,
		"target_uuids": [summoned_uuid],
		"ability_id": (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else &"summon_blessing"),
		"trigger_type": context.trigger_type,
		"action_type": C.ACTION_BUFF,
		"ability_holder_uuid": source_uuid,
		"visual_payload": CombatPayload.hp_buff(source_uuid, hp_amount, [old_hp], [new_hp], [max_hp])
	}))
	
	result.state_applied = true
	return result
```

### File: `scripts/EffectSummonOnDeath.gd`
```gdscript
@tool
class_name EffectSummonOnDeath
extends EffectDefinition
const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

## Summon a random T1 unit when the holder dies
## Uses context data instead of querying instances (Effect Decoupling Rule)

func execute(source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	# The source is an item triggering on_death
	# Context contains data about the dying unit (the holder)
	# Semantic fields: knocked_out_uuid, knocked_out_location
	# 1. Get holder location from context (this is where we summon)
	var holder_location: LocationIdentifier = context.knocked_out_location
	if not is_instance_valid(holder_location):
		return EffectResult.empty()
	
	# Get holder info from context (using new semantic key)
	var holder_uuid: String = context.knocked_out_uuid
	
	# 2. Find this item in the equipped_items snapshot to validate it's the right item
	var equipped_items: Array = context.equipped_items
	var item_found := false
	for item_data in equipped_items:
		if item_data.get("uuid") == source_uuid:
			item_found = true
			break
	
	# If this item wasn't equipped on the dying unit, something is wrong
	if not item_found:
		return EffectResult.empty()

	# 3. Request summon at holder's location
	# We pass the original holder location and UUID.
	# EffectHandlers will handle collision resolution (checking if slot occupied by non-holder)
	# and find an alternative slot if needed using the Unified Summon Slot Finder.

	# 4. Pick a random Tier 1 Unit using centralized summon scoping
	var is_player: bool = BattleHelpers.is_player_team_context(context, holder_location)
	var tier_1_units: Array[GachaBallDefinition] = Database.get_eligible_summon_units(1, is_player)
	assert(not tier_1_units.is_empty(), "EffectSummonOnDeath: no eligible Tier 1 units for is_player=%s" % is_player)
	var random_def: GachaBallDefinition = RNGManager.combat_rng.pick_random(tier_1_units)
	
	# 5. Return EffectResult with summon instructions
	# CombatSimulator will process summon_request via EffectHandlers
	var result := EffectResult.new()
	result.summon_request = {
		"summon_unit_id": random_def.id,
		"holder_uuid": holder_uuid,
		"holder_location": holder_location,
		"spawn_source_uuid": holder_uuid,
		"spawn_source_location": holder_location
	}
	return result
```

```gdscript
extends EffectDefinition
const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

## Summon a random T2 unit when the holder dies
## Uses context data instead of querying instances (Effect Decoupling Rule)

func execute(source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], _battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	# The source is a unit triggering on_death
	# Context contains data about the dying unit
	# Semantic fields: knocked_out_uuid, knocked_out_location
	# 1. Get holder location from context (this is where we summon)
	var holder_location: LocationIdentifier = context.knocked_out_location

	var holder_uuid: String = context.knocked_out_uuid
	
	# Validate this is the correct source (the dying unit must have this ability)
	if source_uuid != holder_uuid:

	# 2. Request summon at holder's location
	# We pass the original holder location and UUID.

	# and find an alternative slot if needed using the Unified Summon Slot Finder.

	var is_player: bool = BattleHelpers.is_player_team_context(context, holder_location)
```

```gdscript
# res://scripts/EffectTransferItemBehind.gd
@tool
class_name EffectTransferItemBehind
extends EffectDefinition

## Transfers the equipped item of the dying unit to the ally behind it.
## Used by the Standard Bearer's Standard's Legacy ability.

func execute(source_uuid: String, targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var is_simulation: bool = context.is_simulation
	
	if targets.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()
	
	var target_uuid: String = targets[0]
	var target = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(target_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(target):
		return EffectResult.empty()
		
	var source = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(source):
		return EffectResult.empty()
	
	var equipped_items: Array = context.equipped_items
	if equipped_items.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()
		
	var item_to_transfer = equipped_items[0]
	var item_uuid: String = item_to_transfer.get("uuid", "")
	if item_uuid.is_empty():
		return EffectResult.empty()
		
	var item = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(item_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(item):
		return EffectResult.empty()

	if is_simulation:
		var result := EffectResult.new()
		result.state_applied = true
		var pass_count = self.parameters.get("pass_count", 1)
		
		# Find units behind
		var units_behind: Array[GachaBallInstance] = []
		
		var current_location: LocationIdentifier = context.knocked_out_location
		var is_player_team: bool = (context.knocked_out_team if not context.knocked_out_team.is_empty() else "PLAYER") == "PLAYER"
		
		var current_container_tag = current_location.container
		var current_index = current_location.index
		
		if current_index != -1 and not current_container_tag.is_empty():
			for i in range(pass_count):
				var container = battle_manager.get_container(current_container_tag)
				if not is_instance_valid(container):
					break
					
				var behind_index: int
				if is_player_team:
					behind_index = current_index - 1
				else:
					behind_index = current_index + 1
					
				if behind_index < 0 or behind_index >= container.get_size():
					break
					
				var behind_uuid = container.get_uuid(behind_index)
				if behind_uuid.is_empty():
					break
					
				var ally_behind = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(behind_uuid)
				if is_instance_valid(ally_behind) and ally_behind.current_hp > 0:
					units_behind.append(ally_behind)
					current_index = behind_index
				else:
					break
				
		var item_def = item.get_definition()
		var item_icon_path: String = ""
		if is_instance_valid(item_def) and is_instance_valid(item_def.icon):
			item_icon_path = item_def.icon.resource_path
		
		# Now iterate and equip a copy for each unit behind
		for i in range(units_behind.size()):
			var tgt = units_behind[i]
			var tgt_uuid = tgt.ball_uuid
			
			var old_pwr: int = tgt.current_pwr
			var old_hp: int = tgt.current_hp
			
			# Each unit behind receives a COPY of the item
			var new_item = GachaBallInstance.new()
			new_item.initialize(item_def)
			var equip_events: Array[CombatEvent] = []
			battle_manager.bm_register_and_equip_item(new_item, tgt_uuid, 0, true, equip_events)
			
			var new_pwr: int = tgt.current_pwr
			var new_hp: int = tgt.current_hp
			
			var target_name = BattleHelpers.get_instance_display_name(tgt)
			var source_name = BattleHelpers.get_instance_display_name(source)
			var item_name = tr(item_def.display_name_key) if item_def else "Item"
			
			var message_payload := CombatPayload.new()
			message_payload.message = tr("ui.transfer_item_msg") % [source_name, item_name, target_name]
			result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.LOG_MESSAGE, {
				"visual_payload": message_payload
			}))
			
			var transfer_payload := CombatPayload.new()
			transfer_payload.item_uuid = new_item.ball_uuid
			transfer_payload.item_icon = item_def.icon if (is_instance_valid(item_def) and "icon" in item_def) else null
			transfer_payload.item_icon_path = item_icon_path
			transfer_payload.old_pwr = old_pwr
			transfer_payload.new_pwr = new_pwr
			transfer_payload.old_hp = old_hp
			transfer_payload.new_hp = new_hp
			
			for ev in equip_events:
				if ev.type == CombatEvent.Type.ITEM_DISCARD and ev.visual_payload != null:
					var d_payload: CombatPayload = ev.visual_payload
					transfer_payload.replaced_item_uuid = d_payload.item_uuid
					transfer_payload.replaced_item_icon = d_payload.item_icon
					transfer_payload.replaced_item_icon_path = d_payload.item_icon_path
					transfer_payload.replaced_item_name = d_payload.item_name
					break
			
			result.add_event(CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.ITEM_TRANSFER, {
				"source_uuid": source_uuid,
				"target_uuids": [tgt_uuid],
				"visual_payload": transfer_payload
			}))
		
		return result
		
	return EffectResult.empty()
```

```gdscript
# res://scripts/EffectUpdatePwrToTokens.gd
@tool
class_name EffectUpdatePwrToTokens
extends EffectDefinition

## Dynamically scales the source unit's PWR based on current Gacha Tokens.
## Updates dynamically whenever the player's token count changes, and when entering the board.
## Applies to both player and enemy Templars, scaling with the player's current token count.
## Preserves outside-battle training upgrades and existing base stats.

const C = preload("res://scripts/Constants.gd")

func execute(source_uuid: String, _targets: Array[String], battle_manager: Node, context: TriggerContext) -> EffectResult:
	var source = battle_manager.get_instance_by_uuid(source_uuid)
	if not is_instance_valid(source) or source.current_hp <= 0:
		return EffectResult.new()

	var current_tokens: int = battle_manager.get_gacha_tokens()
	var multiplier: float = self.parameters.get("multiplier", 1.0)
	var target_bonus: int = int(current_tokens * multiplier)
	var previous_bonus: int = source.get_meta("token_pwr_bonus", 0)
	var delta: int = target_bonus - previous_bonus

	if delta == 0:
		return EffectResult.new()

	# Update tracked bonus metadata
	source.set_meta("token_pwr_bonus", target_bonus)

	# Update status effect for UI/inspection
	var status_key: StringName = &"templar_token_pwr"
	if previous_bonus > 0:
		source.clear_status_effect(status_key)
	if target_bonus > 0:
		source.add_status_effect_silent(status_key, target_bonus)

	var old_pwr: int = source.current_pwr
	var action_type := C.ACTION_BUFF if delta > 0 else C.ACTION_DEBUFF
	var new_pwr: int = battle_manager.apply_stat_delta(source, "pwr", delta, source_uuid, action_type, false)

	var visual_source_uuid := source_uuid
	var payload := CombatPayload.pwr_buff(visual_source_uuid, delta, [old_pwr], [new_pwr]) if delta > 0 else CombatPayload.pwr_debuff(visual_source_uuid, delta, [old_pwr], [new_pwr])

	var event := CombatEvent.new(CombatEvent.Type.BUFF if delta > 0 else CombatEvent.Type.DEBUFF, {
		"source_uuid": visual_source_uuid,
		"target_uuids": [source_uuid],
		"ability_id": (context.ability_id if context.ability_id != &"" else ""),
		"action_type": action_type,
		"ability_holder_uuid": source_uuid,
		"visual_payload": payload
	})

	var result := EffectResult.new()
	result.add_event(event)
	result.state_applied = true
	return result

```
